# Caretaker and web implementation - complete source contents

Complete current files follow. Changed sections are described in caretaker-implementation.md, student-cleanup-verification.md, achievement-removal.md, flashcard-legacy-restoration.md, vercel-deployment.md and web-verification.md. Earlier user changes are preserved. Binary icons reuse the existing app icon; sqlite3.wasm provenance/checksum is recorded in web/DATABASE_ASSETS.md. Backend paths are relative to audy_app.

```dart
void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  // Initialize Supabase first
  await Supabase.initialize(
    url: BuildConfig.supabaseUrl,
    anonKey: BuildConfig.supabasePublishableKey,
  );

  // Initialize services
  await EmotionService.init();

  // Initialize sound service
  try {
    if (!kIsWeb) await SoundService.instance.initialize();
    debugPrint('Sound service initialized successfully');
  } catch (e) {
    debugPrint('Sound service initialization failed: $e');
  }

  // Initialize Bluetooth service
  try {
    if (!kIsWeb) await AudyBluetoothService.instance.initialize();
    debugPrint('Bluetooth service initialized successfully');
  } catch (e) {
    debugPrint('Bluetooth service initialization failed: $e');
  }

  // Initialize database and storage
  bool dbInitialized = false;
  try {
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      await ServiceLocator().initialize();
      dbInitialized = true;
    }
    debugPrint('Database initialized successfully');
  } catch (e) {
    debugPrint('Database initialization failed: $e');
    dbInitialized = false;
  }

  runApp(AudyApp(dbInitialized: dbInitialized));
}

class AudyApp extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool dbInitialized;

  const AudyApp({super.key, this.dbInitialized = false});

  @override
  State<AudyApp> createState() => _AudyAppState();
}

class _AudyAppState extends State<AudyApp> {
  late final AudyController controller;
  final int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _isInitializing = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Only use storage if database was initialized successfully
    controller = AudyController(
      storage: widget.dbInitialized ? ServiceLocator().storageRepository : null,
    );

    // Set up level up callback
    controller.onLevelUp = (newLevel) {
      // Play level up sound
      SoundService.instance.playLevelUp();
      // Level up animation is handled in the rewards page
    };

    // Initialize controller (loads storage + checks auth)
    _initializeApp();
  }

  Future<void> _initializeApp() async {
    await controller.init();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _isInitializing = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    SoundService.instance.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Show splash screen while initializing
    if (_isInitializing) {
      return MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
        home: Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: AudyColors.backgroundPrimary,
          body: Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Icon(
                  Icons.child_care_rounded,
                  size: 80,
                  color: AudyColors.skyBlue,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                Text(
                  'AUDY',
                  style: AudyTypography.displayLarge.copyWith(
                    color: AudyColors.skyBlue,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const CircularProgressIndicator(color: AudyColors.skyBlue),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Determine initial route based on auth state
    final initialRoute = controller.isLoggedIn
        ? AppRoutes.dashboard
        : AppRoutes.login;

    return AudyScope(
      controller: controller,
      child: MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
        title: 'AUDY - Autism-Friendly Learning',
        builder: (context, child) => ListenableBuilder(
          listenable: controller,
          builder: (context, _) {
            final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
            return MediaQuery(
              data: media.copyWith(
                textScaler: controller.appSettings.largerText
                    ? _LargerTextScaler(media.textScaler)
                    : media.textScaler,
              ),
              child: Listener(
                onPointerDown: kIsWeb
                    ? (_) => SoundService.instance.unlockBrowserAudio()
                    : null,
                child: Stack(
                  children: [
                    AbsorbPointer(
                      absorbing: controller.isPreparingWebAccount,
                      child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
                    ),
                    if (controller.isPreparingWebAccount)
                      const Positioned.fill(
                        child: ColoredBox(
                          color: AudyColors.backgroundPrimary,
                          child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (kIsWeb && controller.webStorageMessage != null)
                      Positioned(
                        left: 0,
                        right: 0,
                        bottom: 0,
                        child: Material(
                          color: AudyColors.warning,
                          child: SafeArea(
                            top: false,
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                              child: Text(controller.webStorageMessage!),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
        theme: ThemeData(
          useMaterial3: true,
          scaffoldBackgroundColor: AudyColors.backgroundPrimary,
          colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
            seedColor: AudyColors.skyBlue,
            primary: AudyColors.skyBlue,
            secondary: AudyColors.mintGreen,
            tertiary: AudyColors.activityRewards,
            surface: AudyColors.backgroundCard,
            brightness: Brightness.light,
          ),
          textTheme: TextTheme(
            displayLarge: AudyTypography.displayLarge,
            displayMedium: AudyTypography.displayMedium,
            headlineLarge: AudyTypography.headingLarge,
            headlineMedium: AudyTypography.headingMedium,
            headlineSmall: AudyTypography.headingSmall,
            bodyLarge: AudyTypography.bodyLarge,
            bodyMedium: AudyTypography.bodyMedium,
            bodySmall: AudyTypography.bodySmall,
            labelLarge: AudyTypography.labelLarge,
            labelMedium: AudyTypography.labelMedium,
          ),
          elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size(0, AudySpacing.buttonHeight),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AudySpacing.cardPadding,
                vertical: AudySpacing.elementGap,
              ),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AudySpacing.radiusXLarge),
              ),
              elevation: 4,
              textStyle: AudyTypography.buttonText,
            ),
          ),
          cardTheme: CardThemeData(
            elevation: 4,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AudySpacing.radiusLarge),
            ),
          ),
          appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(
            elevation: 0,
            centerTitle: true,
            backgroundColor: AudyColors.backgroundPrimary,
            foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
          ),
          bottomNavigationBarTheme: BottomNavigationBarThemeData(
            backgroundColor: AudyColors.backgroundCard,
            selectedItemColor: AudyColors.skyBlue,
            unselectedItemColor: AudyColors.textLight,
            type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,
            elevation: 8,
            selectedLabelStyle: AudyTypography.labelMedium.copyWith(
              fontSize: 14,
            ),
            unselectedLabelStyle: AudyTypography.bodySmall.copyWith(
              fontSize: 12,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        initialRoute: initialRoute,
        // A browser refresh cannot restore in-memory game/result arguments.
        // Restore the authenticated home and start a new game from there.
        onGenerateInitialRoutes: kIsWeb
            ? (_) => [
                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (_) => const _HomeShell(currentIndex: 0),
                ),
              ]
            : null,
        onUnknownRoute: kIsWeb
            ? (_) => MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => const _HomeShell(currentIndex: 0),
              )
            : null,
        routes: {
          for (final route in [
            AppRoutes.caretaker,
            AppRoutes.caretakerChildren,
            AppRoutes.caretakerProfile,
            AppRoutes.caretakerCustomization,
            AppRoutes.caretakerEdit,
            AppRoutes.caretakerStudyPlan,
            AppRoutes.caretakerGuide,
            AppRoutes.caretakerAssignments,
            AppRoutes.caretakerLegacyHome,
            AppRoutes.caretakerLegacyProgress,
            AppRoutes.caretakerLegacyProfile,
          ])
            route: (_) => CaretakerRoute(route),
          AppRoutes.login: (_) => const LoginPage(),
          AppRoutes.dashboard: (_) => _HomeShell(currentIndex: _currentIndex),
          AppRoutes.games: (_) => _HomeShell(currentIndex: 1),
          AppRoutes.emotionClassify: (_) => const EmotionClassifyScreen(),
          AppRoutes.emotionMimic: (_) => const EmotionMimicScreen(),
          AppRoutes.miniPuzzle: (_) => const MiniPuzzleGameSelection(),
          AppRoutes.flashcard: (_) => const FlashcardDifficultyScreen(),
          AppRoutes.roadSafety: (_) => const RoadSafetyScreen(),
          AppRoutes.fruitCatchingBear: (_) => const FruitCatchingBearScreen(),
          AppRoutes.readingHub: (_) => const ReadPronounceHub(),
          AppRoutes.letters: (_) => const ReadPronouncePracticeScreen(
            title: 'letters_practice',
            subtitle: 'listen_repeat',
            module: ReadPronounceModule.letters,
          ),
          AppRoutes.words: (_) => const ReadPronouncePracticeScreen(
            title: 'words_practice',
            subtitle: 'simple_words',
            module: ReadPronounceModule.words,
          ),
          AppRoutes.sentences: (_) => const ReadPronouncePracticeScreen(
            title: 'sentences_practice',
            subtitle: 'short_sentences',
            module: ReadPronounceModule.sentences,
          ),
          AppRoutes.social: (_) => const SocialPracticePage(),
          AppRoutes.rewards: (_) => _HomeShell(currentIndex: 2),
          AppRoutes.profile: (_) => _HomeShell(currentIndex: 3),
          AppRoutes.preferences: (_) =>
              const PreferencesPage(isOnboarding: true),
          AppRoutes.meltdown: (_) => const MeltdownScreen(),
          AppRoutes.device: (_) => const DeviceConnectionPage(),
          AppRoutes.assignments: (_) => const AssignmentsPage(),
          AppRoutes.remoteControl: (_) => const RemoteControlPage(),
        },
        onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
          debugPrint('onGenerateRoute: ${settings.name}');
          switch (settings.name) {
            case AppRoutes.meltdown:
              // Slow, calm transition for meltdown screen (2-second cross-fade)
              return PageRouteBuilder(
                pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
                    const MeltdownScreen(),
                transitionsBuilder:
                    (context, animation, secondaryAnimation, child) {
                      return FadeTransition(
                        opacity: animation.drive(
                          CurveTween(
                            curve: const Interval(
                              0.0,
                              1.0,
                              curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: child,
                      );
                    },
                transitionDuration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
                reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
              );
            case AppRoutes.miniPuzzleLevel:
              final gameType = settings.arguments as MiniPuzzleType;
              return MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => MiniPuzzleLevelSelect(gameType: gameType),
              );
            case AppRoutes.miniPuzzleGame:
              debugPrint('Creating MiniPuzzleGameScreen route');
              debugPrint('settings.arguments: ${settings.arguments}');
              try {
                final args = settings.arguments as Map<String, dynamic>;
                debugPrint(
                  'Arguments: gameType=${args['gameType']}, difficulty=${args['difficulty']}',
                );
                return MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (_) => MiniPuzzleGameScreen(
                    gameType: args['gameType'] as MiniPuzzleType,
                    difficulty: args['difficulty'] as MiniPuzzleDifficulty,
                  ),
                );
              } catch (e, stackTrace) {
                debugPrint('Error creating MiniPuzzleGameScreen: $e');
                debugPrint('Stack trace: $stackTrace');
                return null;
              }
            case AppRoutes.miniPuzzleResult:
              final args = settings.arguments as Map<String, dynamic>;
              final sessionData = args['sessionData'] as MiniPuzzleSessionData;
              final controller = args['controller'] as AudyController;
              return MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => MiniPuzzleResultScreen(
                  sessionData: sessionData,
                  controller: controller,
                ),
              );
            default:
              return null;
          }
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HomeShell extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HomeShell({required this.currentIndex});

  final int currentIndex;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = AudyScope.of(context);
    if (!controller.isLoggedIn) return const LoginPage();
    final role = controller.currentUser?.role;
    if (controller.currentUser?.mode == AppMode.caretaker) {
      return CaretakerAccountGuard(
        child: CaretakerShell(
          key: ValueKey(controller.currentUser!.id),
          initialTab: currentIndex == 3
              ? 2
              : currentIndex == 2
              ? 1
              : 0,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (controller.currentUser?.mode == AppMode.unknown) {
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: Text('This account role is not supported.')),
      );
    }
    final isCaregiver = role == 'parent' || role == 'teacher';
    final pages = isCaregiver
        ? const <Widget>[DashboardPage(), RewardsPage(), ProfilePage()]
        : const <Widget>[
            DashboardPage(),
            GamesHubPage(),
            RewardsPage(),
            ProfilePage(),
          ];
    final routes = isCaregiver
        ? const [AppRoutes.dashboard, AppRoutes.rewards, AppRoutes.profile]
        : const [
            AppRoutes.dashboard,
            AppRoutes.games,
            AppRoutes.rewards,
            AppRoutes.profile,
          ];
    final selectedIndex = isCaregiver
        ? switch (currentIndex) {
            2 => 1,
            3 => 2,
            _ => 0,
          }
        : currentIndex;

    return Scaffold(
      body: pages[selectedIndex],
      bottomNavigationBar: BottomNavigationBar(
        currentIndex: selectedIndex,
        onTap: (index) {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, routes[index]);
        },
        items: [
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
            label: controller.tr('home'),
          ),
          if (!isCaregiver)
            BottomNavigationBarItem(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.sports_esports_rounded),
              label: controller.tr('games'),
            ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded),
            label: controller.tr(isCaregiver ? 'child_progress' : 'rewards'),
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.person_rounded),
            label: controller.tr('profile'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LargerTextScaler extends TextScaler {
  const _LargerTextScaler(this.base);
  final TextScaler base;
  @override
  double scale(double fontSize) => base.scale(fontSize) * 1.2;
  @override
  double get textScaleFactor => base.scale(14) / 14 * 1.2;
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../state/audy_controller.dart';

final class AppRoutes {
  static final _pendingBreakChecks = <NavigatorState>{};
  static const caretaker = '/caretaker';
  static const caretakerChildren = '/caretaker/children';
  static const caretakerProfile = '/caretaker/profile';
  static const caretakerCustomization = '/caretaker/customization';
  static const caretakerEdit = '/caretaker/customization/edit';
  static const caretakerStudyPlan = '/caretaker/study-plan';
  static const caretakerGuide = '/caretaker/guide';
  static const caretakerAssignments = '/caretaker/assignments-rewards';
  static const caretakerLegacyHome = '/caretaker/legacy/home';
  static const caretakerLegacyProgress = '/caretaker/legacy/progress';
  static const caretakerLegacyProfile = '/caretaker/legacy/profile';
  static const login = '/login';
  static const dashboard = '/';
  static const games = '/games';
  static const emotionClassify = '/games/emotion-classify';
  static const emotionMimic = '/games/emotion-mimic';
  static const miniPuzzle = '/games/mini-puzzle';
  static const miniPuzzleLevel = '/games/mini-puzzle/level';
  static const miniPuzzleGame = '/games/mini-puzzle/play';
  static const miniPuzzleResult = '/games/mini-puzzle/result';
  static const flashcard = '/games/flashcard';
  static const roadSafety = '/games/road-safety';
  static const fruitCatchingBear = '/games/fruit-catching-bear';
  static const readingHub = '/reading';
  static const letters = '/reading/letters';
  static const words = '/reading/words';
  static const sentences = '/reading/sentences';
  static const social = '/social';
  static const rewards = '/rewards';
  static const profile = '/profile';
  static const preferences = '/preferences';
  static const meltdown = '/meltdown';
  static const device = '/device';
  static const assignments = '/assignments';
  static const remoteControl = '/remote-control';

  /// Navigate after game completion, checking if meltdown protection should trigger.
  /// Uses the current Student account's configured game-count threshold.
  /// Otherwise, pops back to the games hub.
  static Future<void> navigateAfterGameCompletion(
    BuildContext context,
    AudyController controller,
  ) async {
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    if (!_pendingBreakChecks.add(navigator)) return;
    try {
      final accountId = controller.currentUser?.id;
      await controller.refreshBreakSettings();
      if (!context.mounted || controller.currentUser?.id != accountId) return;
      if (controller.shouldTriggerMeltdown) {
        navigator.pushNamed(meltdown);
      } else {
        navigator.popUntil((route) => route.settings.name == games);
      }
    } finally {
      _pendingBreakChecks.remove(navigator);
    }
  }
}
```

## lib/src/data/models/game_configuration.dart
```dart
import 'dart:convert';

enum CaretakerGame { socialChat, flashcard, miniPuzzle, emotion, fruitCatch }

extension CaretakerGameKey on CaretakerGame {
  String get key => const [
    'social_chat',
    'flashcard',
    'minipuzzle',
    'emotion',
    'fruit_catching_bear',
  ][index];
  String get title => const [
    'Social Chat',
    'FlashCard',
    'MiniPuzzle',
    'Emotion',
    'Fruit Catch',
  ][index];
}

/// An immutable snapshot. Editors use a deep copy; previews never own a save API.
class GameConfiguration {
  GameConfiguration(this.game, Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : _encoded = jsonEncode(values);
  final CaretakerGame game;
  final String _encoded;
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => jsonDecode(_encoded) as Map<String, dynamic>;
  factory GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame game) =>
      GameConfiguration(game, switch (game) {
        CaretakerGame.socialChat => {
          'input_mode': 'text_and_voice',
          'reply_speech': 'automatic',
          'listen_seconds': 30,
          'pause_seconds': 3,
          'starter_phrases': <String>[],
        },
        CaretakerGame.flashcard => {
          'difficulty': 'child_choice',
          'language': 'app',
          'preview_pace': '2_seconds',
          'auto_speak': true,
          'use_custom_cards': false,
          'custom_cards': <dynamic>[],
        },
        CaretakerGame.miniPuzzle => {
          'enabled_types': ['pattern', 'oddOneOut', 'puzzle'],
          'pattern_difficulty': 'child_choice',
          'odd_one_out_difficulty': 'child_choice',
          'puzzle_difficulty': 'child_choice',
          'advance_mode': 'automatic_900ms',
          'show_guide': true,
        },
        CaretakerGame.emotion => {
          'target_emotions': ['happy', 'sad', 'angry', 'scared'],
          'choice_count': 4,
          'round_count': 3,
          'image_mode': 'varied',
          'advance_mode': 'automatic_1500ms',
          'show_guide': true,
        },
        CaretakerGame.fruitCatch => {
          'fall_speed': 'standard',
          'spawn_interval_ms': 900,
          'bomb_probability': 0.2,
          'bomb_grace_count': 2,
          'duration_seconds': null,
          'fruit_ids': ['4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9'],
          'show_guide': true,
        },
      });

  List<String> validate() {
    final v = toJson();
    final errors = <String>[];
    final expectedKeys = GameConfiguration.defaults(game).toJson().keys.toSet();
    if (v.keys.any((key) => !expectedKeys.contains(key))) {
      errors.add('These settings need a newer app version.');
    }
    void choice(String field, List<dynamic> allowed) {
      final value = v[field];
      final integerOnly =
          allowed.whereType<int>().isNotEmpty &&
          allowed.whereType<double>().isEmpty;
      if (!v.containsKey(field) ||
          !allowed.contains(value) ||
          (integerOnly && value != null && value is! int)) {
        errors.add('Invalid $field');
      }
    }

    void subset(String field, List<String> allowed, int minimum) {
      final items = v[field];
      if (items is! List ||
          items.length < minimum ||
          items.toSet().length != items.length ||
          items.any((x) => !allowed.contains(x))) {
        errors.add('Choose valid $field');
      }
    }

    void flag(String field) {
      if (v[field] is! bool) errors.add('Invalid $field');
    }

    const levels = ['child_choice', 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'];
    switch (game) {
      case CaretakerGame.socialChat:
        choice('input_mode', ['text_and_voice', 'text_only']);
        choice('reply_speech', ['automatic', 'on_tap']);
        choice('listen_seconds', [15, 30, 45]);
        choice('pause_seconds', [3, 5, 8]);
        final phrases = v['starter_phrases'];
        if (phrases is! List ||
            phrases.length > 6 ||
            phrases.any(
              (x) =>
                  x is! String ||
                  x.trim().isEmpty ||
                  x.length > 80 ||
                  x != x.trim(),
            ) ||
            phrases.toSet().length != phrases.length) {
          errors.add('Use up to six unique starter phrases (1–80 characters).');
        }
      case CaretakerGame.flashcard:
        choice('difficulty', levels);
        choice('language', ['app', 'en', 'th']);
        choice('preview_pace', [
          '2_seconds',
          '3_seconds',
          '5_seconds',
          'manual',
        ]);
        flag('auto_speak');
        flag('use_custom_cards');
        final cards = v['custom_cards'];
        if (cards is! List || cards.length > 20) {
          errors.add('Use up to 20 custom cards.');
          break;
        }
        final ids = <String>{};
        final words = <String>{};
        for (final card in cards) {
          if (card is! Map ||
              card['id'] is! String ||
              (card['id'] as String).isEmpty ||
              !ids.add(card['id'] as String) ||
              card['word'] is! String ||
              (card['word'] as String).trim().isEmpty ||
              (card['word'] as String).length > 40 ||
              ![
                'noun',
                'pronoun',
                'verb',
                'adjective',
                'adverb',
              ].contains(card['category']) ||
              !words.add(
                '${card['category']}:${card['word'].toString().trim().toLowerCase()}',
              )) {
            errors.add(
              'Each card needs a unique ID, word (1–40 characters), and word type.',
            );
            continue;
          }
          final image = card['image_url'];
          if (image != null && image is! String) {
            errors.add('Invalid card image.');
            continue;
          }
          if (image is String && image.isNotEmpty) {
            if (image.startsWith('data:image/jpeg;base64,') ||
                image.startsWith('data:image/png;base64,')) {
              try {
                if (base64Decode(image.split(',').last).length > 131072) {
                  errors.add('Card pictures must be at most 128 KiB.');
                }
              } catch (_) {
                errors.add('Invalid card image.');
              }
            } else if (!RegExp(
              r'^assets/images/games/flashcard/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]+\.png$',
            ).hasMatch(image)) {
              errors.add('Choose a bundled picture or upload a picture.');
            }
          }
        }
        if (v['use_custom_cards'] == true && cards.isEmpty) {
          errors.add('Add a card before enabling custom cards.');
        }
      case CaretakerGame.miniPuzzle:
        subset('enabled_types', ['pattern', 'oddOneOut', 'puzzle'], 1);
        for (final field in [
          'pattern_difficulty',
          'odd_one_out_difficulty',
          'puzzle_difficulty',
        ]) {
          choice(field, levels);
        }
        choice('advance_mode', [
          'automatic_900ms',
          'automatic_1800ms',
          'manual',
        ]);
        flag('show_guide');
      case CaretakerGame.emotion:
        subset('target_emotions', ['happy', 'sad', 'angry', 'scared'], 2);
        choice('choice_count', [2, 4]);
        choice('round_count', [1, 3, 5]);
        choice('image_mode', ['varied', 'consistent']);
        choice('advance_mode', [
          'automatic_1500ms',
          'automatic_3000ms',
          'manual',
        ]);
        flag('show_guide');
        if (v['target_emotions'] is List &&
            v['choice_count'] is int &&
            (v['target_emotions'] as List).length <
                (v['choice_count'] as int)) {
          errors.add('Select at least as many emotions as answer choices.');
        }
      case CaretakerGame.fruitCatch:
        choice('fall_speed', ['slow', 'standard', 'fast']);
        choice('spawn_interval_ms', [900, 1200, 1500]);
        choice('bomb_probability', [0, 0.1, 0.2]);
        choice('bomb_grace_count', [2, 5, 10]);
        choice('duration_seconds', [null, 30, 60, 120]);
        subset('fruit_ids', ['4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9'], 1);
        flag('show_guide');
        if (v['bomb_probability'] == 0 && v['duration_seconds'] == null) {
          errors.add('Choose a session duration when bombs are disabled.');
        }
    }
    if (utf8.encode(_encoded).length > 2097152) {
      errors.add('Configuration must be at most 2 MiB.');
    }
    return errors;
  }
}

class SavedGameConfiguration {
  const SavedGameConfiguration(
    this.config,
    this.revision, {
    this.schemaVersion = 1,
  });
  final GameConfiguration config;
  final int revision;
  final int schemaVersion;
  bool get editable => schemaVersion == 1;
}

class SocialChatConfig extends GameConfiguration {
  SocialChatConfig(Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : super(CaretakerGame.socialChat, values);
}

class FlashcardConfig extends GameConfiguration {
  FlashcardConfig(Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : super(CaretakerGame.flashcard, values);
}

class MiniPuzzleCustomizationConfig extends GameConfiguration {
  MiniPuzzleCustomizationConfig(Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : super(CaretakerGame.miniPuzzle, values);
}

class EmotionConfig extends GameConfiguration {
  EmotionConfig(Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : super(CaretakerGame.emotion, values);
}

class FruitCatchConfig extends GameConfiguration {
  FruitCatchConfig(Map<String, dynamic> values)
    : super(CaretakerGame.fruitCatch, values);
}
```

## lib/src/data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart
```dart
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../models/game_configuration.dart';
import '../models/child_progress_snapshot.dart';

class CaretakerFailure implements Exception {
  const CaretakerFailure(this.message, {this.conflict = false});
  final String message;
  final bool conflict;
  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

String caretakerError(Object error) {
  if (error is CaretakerFailure) return error.message;
  if (error is PostgrestException) {
    if (error.code == '40001') {
      return 'Another Caretaker saved changes. Reload before saving again.';
    }
    if (error.code == 'PGRST202' || error.code == '42P01') {
      return 'Caretaker storage is not installed yet. Apply the Caretaker database migration, then retry.';
    }
    if (error.code == '42501') {
      return 'This child is no longer available for your account. Reload your care list.';
    }
    if (error.code == '22023') {
      return 'Check the selected children or game settings and try again.';
    }
  }
  return 'Could not connect. Your changes are still here. Please try again.';
}

class CaretakerChild {
  CaretakerChild(this.profile, this.inCare);
  final UserProfile profile;
  final bool inCare;
}

class CaretakerRoster {
  CaretakerRoster(this.children, this.plannedCount, this.revision);
  final List<CaretakerChild> children;
  final int plannedCount;
  final int revision;
}

class CaretakerRepository {
  CaretakerRepository(this.client);
  final SupabaseClient client;
  Future<CaretakerRoster> load() async {
    final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
      await client.rpc('caretaker_roster'),
    );
    final children = (data['children'] as List).map((row) {
      final json = Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map)..['role'] = 'child';
      return CaretakerChild(
        UserProfile.fromJson(json),
        json['is_in_care'] as bool,
      );
    }).toList();
    return CaretakerRoster(
      children,
      data['planned_count'] as int,
      data['revision'] as int,
    );
  }

  Future<void> link(String email) async => await client.rpc(
    'caretaker_link_child',
    params: {'child_email': email.trim()},
  );
  Future<void> save(int count, Set<String> ids, int revision) async {
    await client.rpc(
      'caretaker_save_roster',
      params: {
        'planned_count': count,
        'child_ids': ids.toList(),
        'expected_revision': revision,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<ChildProgressSnapshot> progress(String childId) async =>
      ChildProgressSnapshot.fromJson(
        Map<String, dynamic>.from(
          await client.rpc(
            'caretaker_child_progress',
            params: {'target_child': childId},
          ),
        ),
      );

  Future<List<ClassWord>> legacyWords() async {
    final rows = await client
        .from('class_words')
        .select()
        .eq('teacher_id', client.auth.currentUser!.id);
    return rows.map(ClassWord.fromJson).toList();
  }
}

class GameConfigurationRepository {
  GameConfigurationRepository(this.client);
  final SupabaseClient client;
  Future<SavedGameConfiguration> load(
    String childId,
    CaretakerGame game,
  ) async {
    final row = await client
        .from('child_game_configs')
        .select()
        .eq('child_id', childId)
        .eq('game_key', game.key)
        .maybeSingle();
    if (row == null) {
      return SavedGameConfiguration(GameConfiguration.defaults(game), 0);
    }
    final config = GameConfiguration(
      game,
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(row['payload'] as Map),
    );
    final version = row['schema_version'] as int;
    if (version == 1 && config.validate().isNotEmpty) {
      throw const CaretakerFailure(
        'Saved settings are invalid. Please contact support before replacing them.',
      );
    }
    return SavedGameConfiguration(
      config,
      row['revision'] as int,
      schemaVersion: version,
    );
  }

  Future<Set<String>> summaries(String childId) async {
    final rows = await client
        .from('child_game_configs')
        .select('game_key')
        .eq('child_id', childId);
    return rows.map((r) => r['game_key'] as String).toSet();
  }

  Future<SavedGameConfiguration> save(
    String childId,
    GameConfiguration config,
    int revision,
  ) async {
    final errors = config.validate();
    if (errors.isNotEmpty) throw CaretakerFailure(errors.join('\n'));
    final result = await client.rpc(
      'caretaker_save_config',
      params: {
        'target_child': childId,
        'target_game': config.game.key,
        'config_payload': config.toJson(),
        'expected_revision': revision,
      },
    );
    return SavedGameConfiguration(config, (result as num).toInt());
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

                  onTap: () => _handleDebugLogin(
                    email: 'test@audy.com',
                    password: 'password123',
                    mode: AppMode.child,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: _buildDebugButton(
                  label: 'Caretaker',
                  icon: Icons.supervisor_account_rounded,
                  color: AudyColors.mintGreen,
                  onTap: () => _handleDebugLogin(
                    email: 'caretaker@gmail.com',
                    password: 'audy123',
                    mode: AppMode.caretaker,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDebugButton({
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _busy ? null : onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AudySpacing.radiusMedium),
          border: Border.all(color: color, width: 1.5),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(icon, color: color, size: 24),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: color,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _handleDebugLogin({
    required String email,
    required String password,
    required AppMode mode,
  }) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    SoundService.instance.playTap();
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
      _successMessage = null;
    });
    try {
      await _authService.signIn(email: email, password: password);
      final profile = await _authService.getCurrentProfile();
      if (profile == null || profile.mode != mode) {
        await _authService.signOut();
        throw StateError('The debug account has an unexpected role.');
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      await AudyScope.of(context).setUser(profile);
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
        context,
        AppRoutes.dashboard,
        (_) => false,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _emailController.text = email;
          _isSignUp = false;
          _errorMessage = AudyScope.of(context).currentLanguage == 'th'
              ? '\u0e40\u0e02\u0e49\u0e32\u0e2a\u0e39\u0e48\u0e23\u0e30\u0e1a\u0e1a\u0e44\u0e21\u0e48\u0e2a\u0e33\u0e40\u0e23\u0e47\u0e08 \u0e01\u0e23\u0e38\u0e13\u0e32\u0e25\u0e2d\u0e07\u0e2d\u0e35\u0e01\u0e04\u0e23\u0e31\u0e49\u0e07'
              : 'Could not sign in to $email. Please try again or sign in manually.';
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleSubmit() async {
    SoundService.instance.playTap();

    // Validate inputs
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text;

    if (email.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _errorMessage = _tr('enter_email'));
      return;
    }

    if (password.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _errorMessage = _tr('enter_password'));
      return;
    }

    if (_isSignUp) {
      final name = _nameController.text.trim();
      if (name.isEmpty) {
        setState(() => _errorMessage = _tr('enter_name'));
        return;
      }
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
      _successMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      if (_isSignUp) {
        // Sign up
        await _authService.signUp(
          email: email,
          password: password,
          name: _nameController.text.trim(),
          age: _selectedRole == 'child' ? _selectedAge : 0,
          role: _selectedRole,
        );

        // Get profile and set in controller
        final profile = await _authService.getCurrentProfile();
        if (profile != null && mounted) {
          await AudyScope.of(context).setUser(profile);
          if (!mounted) return;
          if (profile.role == 'child') {
            Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.preferences);
          } else {
            Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
          }
          return;
        }
      } else {
        // Sign in
        await _authService.signIn(email: email, password: password);

        // Get user profile and set in controller
        final profile = await _authService.getCurrentProfile();
        if (profile != null && mounted) {
          await AudyScope.of(context).setUser(profile);
          if (!mounted) return;
        }

        // Navigate to dashboard
        if (mounted) {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(
        () => _errorMessage = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', ''),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../../core/app_routes.dart';
import '../../data/models/game_configuration.dart';
import '../../data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart';
import '../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../../state/caretaker_controller.dart';
import '../parent/parent_dashboard.dart';
import '../parent/parent_profile_page.dart';
import '../parent/parent_child_progress_page.dart';
import '../teacher/teacher_dashboard.dart';
import '../teacher/teacher_profile_page.dart';
import '../teacher/teacher_child_progress_page.dart';
import 'caretaker_shell.dart';
import 'caretaker_ui.dart';
import 'customization/customization_page.dart';
import 'customization/game_editor.dart';

class CaretakerEditorArguments {
  const CaretakerEditorArguments(this.childId, this.game);
  final String childId;
  final CaretakerGame game;
}

class CaretakerRoute extends StatelessWidget {
  const CaretakerRoute(this.route, {super.key});
  final String route;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      CaretakerAccountGuard(child: _page(context));
  Widget _page(BuildContext context) {
    final role = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.role;
    if (route == AppRoutes.caretaker) return const CaretakerShell();
    if (route == AppRoutes.caretakerChildren) {
      return const CaretakerShell(initialTab: 2, manageChildren: true);
    }
    if (route == AppRoutes.caretakerProfile) {
      return const CaretakerShell(initialTab: 2);
    }
    if (route == AppRoutes.caretakerCustomization) {
      return const _CustomizationEntry();
    }
    if (route == AppRoutes.caretakerEdit) {
      final args = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
      if (args is CaretakerEditorArguments) {
        return _CustomizationEntry(arguments: args);
      }
    }
    if (route.contains('/legacy/') && (role == 'parent' || role == 'teacher')) {
      final parent = role == 'parent';
      final page = switch (route) {
        AppRoutes.caretakerLegacyHome =>
          parent ? const ParentDashboard() : const TeacherDashboard(),
        AppRoutes.caretakerLegacyProgress =>
          parent
              ? const ParentChildProgressPage()
              : const TeacherChildProgressPage(),
        _ => parent ? const ParentProfilePage() : const TeacherProfilePage(),
      };
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(ct(context, 'Legacy tools', 'เครื่องมือเดิม')),
        ),
        body: page,
      );
    }
    final title = switch (route) {
      AppRoutes.caretakerStudyPlan => ct(context, 'Study Plan', 'แผนการเรียน'),
      AppRoutes.caretakerGuide => ct(context, 'Manual / Guide', 'คู่มือ'),
      AppRoutes.caretakerAssignments => ct(
        context,
        'Assignments & Rewards',
        'งานและรางวัล',
      ),
      _ => ct(context, 'Unavailable', 'ไม่พร้อมใช้งาน'),
    };
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(title)),
      body: CaretakerPageBody(
        children: [
          Center(
            child: Text(
              ct(
                context,
                'TBD — Not available in this phase',
                'TBD — ยังไม่เปิดใช้งานในระยะนี้',
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CustomizationEntry extends StatefulWidget {
  const _CustomizationEntry({this.arguments});
  final CaretakerEditorArguments? arguments;
  @override
  State<_CustomizationEntry> createState() => _CustomizationEntryState();
}

class _CustomizationEntryState extends State<_CustomizationEntry> {
  CaretakerController? _controller;
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_controller != null) return;
    final id = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id;
    if (id != null) {
      _controller = CaretakerController(
        id,
        CaretakerRepository(Supabase.instance.client),
      );
      _controller!.load();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _controller;
    if (c == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: c,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final args = widget.arguments;
        if (args == null) return CustomizationPage(controller: c);
        if (c.loading) {
          return const Scaffold(
            body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
          );
        }
        if (c.error != null) {
          return Scaffold(body: CaretakerNotice(c.error!, onRetry: c.load));
        }
        final child = c.children
            .where((ch) => ch.id == args.childId)
            .firstOrNull;
        if (child == null) {
          return Scaffold(
            body: Center(
              child: Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Choose a child in your care list.',
                  'เลือกเด็กในความดูแล',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
        return GameEditor(
          key: ValueKey('${child.id}:${args.game.key}'),
          child: child,
          game: args.game,
          repository: GameConfigurationRepository(Supabase.instance.client),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
class CaretakerShell extends StatefulWidget {
  const CaretakerShell({

    this.initialTab = 0,
    this.manageChildren = false,
    this.repository,
  });
  final int initialTab;
  final bool manageChildren;
  final CaretakerRepository? repository;
  @override
  State<CaretakerShell> createState() => _CaretakerShellState();
}

class _CaretakerShellState extends State<CaretakerShell> {
  CaretakerController? _controller;
  late int _tab = widget.initialTab;
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final account = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser;
    if (_controller?.accountId == account?.id) return;
    _controller?.dispose();
    _controller = null;
    if (account?.mode == AppMode.caretaker) {
      _controller = CaretakerController(
        account!.id,
        widget.repository ?? CaretakerRepository(Supabase.instance.client),
      );
      _controller!.load();
      if (widget.manageChildren) {
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          if (mounted) _manageChildren(_controller!);
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _open(Widget page) => Navigator.push<void>(
    context,
    MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => CaretakerAccountGuard(child: page)),
  );

  Future<void> _manageChildren(CaretakerController c) => _open(
    Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(ct(context, 'Manage Children', 'จัดการเด็ก'))),

  Widget? _legacyTools(UserProfile account) {

                ? const ParentDashboard()
                : const TeacherDashboard(),
          ),

        ListTile(
          minVerticalPadding: 16,
          leading: const Icon(Icons.card_giftcard_outlined),
          title: Text(ct(context, 'Existing rewards', 'รางวัลเดิม')),
          trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
          onTap: () => _open(
            ParentChildProgressPage(forTeacher: account.role == 'teacher'),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../../core/audy_ui.dart';
import '../../services/auth_service.dart';

class CaretakerAccountGuard extends StatefulWidget {
  const CaretakerAccountGuard({super.key, required this.child});
  final Widget child;
  @override
  State<CaretakerAccountGuard> createState() => _CaretakerAccountGuardState();
}

class _CaretakerAccountGuardState extends State<CaretakerAccountGuard> {
  String? _accountId;
  bool _captured = false;
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (!_captured) {
      _accountId = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id;
      _captured = true;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser;
    if (user?.mode != AppMode.caretaker || user?.id != _accountId) {
      return Scaffold(
        body: Center(
          child: Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'This Caretaker session has ended.',
              'สิ้นสุดเซสชันผู้ดูแลแล้ว',
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return AudyControls(child: widget.child);
  }
}

String ct(BuildContext context, String english, String thai) =>
    AudyScope.of(context).currentLanguage == 'th' ? thai : english;

class CaretakerNotice extends StatelessWidget {
  const CaretakerNotice(this.message, {super.key, this.onRetry});
  final String message;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(message),
        if (onRetry != null)
          TextButton.icon(
            onPressed: onRetry,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            label: Text(ct(context, 'Retry', 'ลองอีกครั้ง')),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class CaretakerPageBody extends StatelessWidget {
  const CaretakerPageBody({super.key, required this.children});
  final List<Widget> children;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AudyResponsivePage(
    builder: (context, adaptive) => AudyPanel(
      adaptive: adaptive,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: children,
      ),
    ),
  );
}

Future<bool> confirmLeave(
  BuildContext context,
  Future<bool> Function() save,
) async {
  final answer = await showDialog<String>(
    context: context,
    builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
      title: Text(
        ct(context, 'Unsaved changes', 'มีการเปลี่ยนแปลงที่ยังไม่บันทึก'),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, 'stay'),
          child: Text(ct(context, 'Stay', 'อยู่หน้านี้')),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, 'discard'),
          child: Text(ct(context, 'Discard', 'ละทิ้ง')),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, 'save'),
          child: Text(ct(context, 'Save and continue', 'บันทึกและไปต่อ')),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  return answer == 'discard' || (answer == 'save' && await save());
}
```

## lib/src/features/caretaker/children_page.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart';
import '../../state/caretaker_controller.dart';
import 'caretaker_ui.dart';

class ChildrenPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChildrenPage({super.key, required this.controller});
  final CaretakerController controller;
  @override
  State<ChildrenPage> createState() => ChildrenPageState();
}

class ChildrenPageState extends State<ChildrenPage> {
  final _count = TextEditingController();
  final _email = TextEditingController();
  Set<String> _ids = {};
  int? _revision;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;
  CaretakerRoster? _baseline;
  bool get _dirty =>
      _baseline != null &&
      (_count.text != '${_baseline!.plannedCount}' ||
          _ids.length != _baseline!.children.where((c) => c.inCare).length ||
          _baseline!.children.any(
            (c) => c.inCare != _ids.contains(c.profile.id),
          ));
  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ChildrenPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    _initialize();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initialize();
  }

  void _initialize() {
    final roster = widget.controller.roster;
    if (roster == null || _baseline != null) return;
    _baseline = roster;
    _revision = roster.revision;
    _count.text = '${roster.plannedCount}';
    _ids = roster.children
        .where((c) => c.inCare)
        .map((c) => c.profile.id)
        .toSet();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _count.dispose();
    _email.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<bool> leave() async =>
      !_busy && (!_dirty || await confirmLeave(context, _save));
  Future<bool> _save() async {
    final count = int.tryParse(_count.text);
    if (count == null ||
        count < 0 ||
        count > 2147483647 ||
        count < _ids.length) {
      setState(
        () => _error = ct(
          context,
          'Choose a whole number at least ${_ids.length}.',
          'เลือกจำนวนเต็มอย่างน้อย ${_ids.length}',
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await widget.controller.repository.save(count, _ids, _revision!);
      await widget.controller.load();
      if (!mounted) return false;
      _baseline = null;
      _initialize();
      setState(
        () => _error = ct(context, 'Care list saved.', 'บันทึกรายชื่อแล้ว'),
      );
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = caretakerError(e));
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _link() async {
    if (_dirty && !await leave()) return;
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (!_email.text.trim().contains('@')) {
      setState(
        () => _error = ct(
          context,
          'Enter the child account email.',
          'กรอกอีเมลบัญชีเด็ก',
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      await widget.controller.repository.link(_email.text);
      await widget.controller.load();
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (widget.controller.error != null) {
        setState(() => _error = widget.controller.error);
        return;
      }
      _baseline = null;
      _initialize();
      _email.clear();
      setState(
        () => _error = ct(
          context,
          'Account linked. Select this child and save your care list.',
          'เชื่อมบัญชีแล้ว เลือกเด็กและบันทึกรายชื่อ',
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = caretakerError(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    _initialize();
    final c = widget.controller;
    return PopScope(
      canPop: !_dirty && !_busy,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
        if (!didPop && await leave() && context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
      },
      child: CaretakerPageBody(
        children: [
          Text(
            ct(context, 'Children in my care', 'เด็กในความดูแล'),
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
          ),
          if (c.loading) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
          if (c.error != null) CaretakerNotice(c.error!, onRetry: c.load),
          if (_baseline != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            TextField(
              controller: _count,
              enabled: !_busy,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                prefixIcon: IconButton(
                  tooltip: ct(context, 'Fewer children', 'ลดจำนวนเด็ก'),
                  onPressed: _busy
                      ? null
                      : () => setState(() {
                          final value = int.tryParse(_count.text) ?? 0;
                          if (value > 0) _count.text = '${value - 1}';
                        }),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.remove),
                ),
                suffixIcon: IconButton(
                  tooltip: ct(context, 'More children', 'เพิ่มจำนวนเด็ก'),
                  onPressed: _busy
                      ? null
                      : () => setState(() {
                          final value = int.tryParse(_count.text) ?? 0;
                          if (value < 2147483647) _count.text = '${value + 1}';
                        }),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                ),
                helperMaxLines: 3,
                labelText: ct(
                  context,
                  'How many children will you care for?',
                  'คุณจะดูแลเด็กกี่คน?',
                ),
                helperText: ct(
                  context,
                  '${_ids.length} real profiles selected. Extra places do not create accounts.',
                  'เลือก ${_ids.length} บัญชี จำนวนที่เพิ่มไม่สร้างบัญชีใหม่',
                ),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            for (final child in c.roster!.children)
              CheckboxListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Text(child.profile.name),
                subtitle: Text(
                  ct(
                    context,
                    'Age ${child.profile.age}',
                    'อายุ ${child.profile.age} ปี',
                  ),
                ),
                value: _ids.contains(child.profile.id),
                onChanged: _busy
                    ? null
                    : (selected) => setState(() {
                        if (selected == true) {
                          _ids.add(child.profile.id);
                        } else {
                          _ids.remove(child.profile.id);
                        }
                      }),
              ),
            if (c.roster!.children.isEmpty)
              Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Link an existing Child account below.',
                  'เชื่อมบัญชีเด็กที่มีอยู่ด้านล่าง',
                ),
              ),
            if (_error != null) CaretakerNotice(_error!),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : _save,
              child: Text(ct(context, 'Save care list', 'บันทึกรายชื่อ')),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _busy
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      await c.load();
                      if (mounted) {
                        setState(() {
                          _baseline = null;
                          _initialize();
                        });
                      }
                    },
              child: Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Reload saved care list',
                  'โหลดรายชื่อที่บันทึกใหม่',
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 40),
            Text(
              ct(context, 'Link existing child', 'เชื่อมบัญชีเด็กที่มีอยู่'),
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: _email,
              enabled: !_busy,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: ct(context, 'Child account email', 'อีเมลบัญชีเด็ก'),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : _link,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.link),
              label: Text(ct(context, 'Link account', 'เชื่อมบัญชี')),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ConfigurationForm extends StatelessWidget {
  const ConfigurationForm({
    super.key,
    required this.game,
    required this.values,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final CaretakerGame game;
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  final void Function(String, dynamic) onChanged;
  Widget _select(
    BuildContext context,
    String field,
    String en,
    String th,
    List<dynamic> options, {
    List<String>? labels,
    bool enabled = true,
  }) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
    child: DropdownButtonFormField<dynamic>(
      key: ValueKey('$field-${values[field]}'),
      initialValue: values[field],
      isExpanded: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: ct(context, en, th),
        border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
      ),
      items: [
        for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++)
          DropdownMenuItem(
            value: options[i],
            child: Text(labels?[i] ?? _label(context, options[i])),
          ),
      ],
      onChanged: enabled ? (value) => onChanged(field, value) : null,
    ),
  );
  String _label(BuildContext c, dynamic value) {
    const labels = {
      'child_choice': ['Child chooses', 'เด็กเลือกเอง'],
      'easy': ['Easy', 'ง่าย'],
      'medium': ['Medium', 'ปานกลาง'],
      'hard': ['Hard', 'ยาก'],
      'app': ['App language', 'ภาษาของแอป'],
      'manual': ['Manual / Next', 'กดถัดไปเอง'],
      'automatic': ['Automatic', 'อัตโนมัติ'],
      'on_tap': ['On tap', 'เมื่อกด'],
      'text_and_voice': ['Text and voice', 'ข้อความและเสียง'],
      'text_only': ['Text only', 'ข้อความเท่านั้น'],
      'varied': ['Varied', 'เปลี่ยนรูป'],
      'consistent': ['Consistent', 'ใช้รูปเดิม'],
      'slow': ['Slow', 'ช้า'],
      'standard': ['Standard', 'ปกติ'],
      'fast': ['Fast', 'เร็ว'],
      '2_seconds': ['2 seconds', '2 วินาที'],
      '3_seconds': ['3 seconds', '3 วินาที'],
      '5_seconds': ['5 seconds', '5 วินาที'],
      'automatic_900ms': ['Automatic · 0.9 seconds', 'อัตโนมัติ · 0.9 วินาที'],
      'automatic_1800ms': ['Automatic · 1.8 seconds', 'อัตโนมัติ · 1.8 วินาที'],
      'automatic_1500ms': ['Automatic · 1.5 seconds', 'อัตโนมัติ · 1.5 วินาที'],
      'automatic_3000ms': ['Automatic · 3 seconds', 'อัตโนมัติ · 3 วินาที'],
    };
    final pair = labels[value];
    return pair == null ? '$value' : ct(c, pair[0], pair[1]);
  }

  Widget _flag(BuildContext c, String field, String en, String th) =>
      SwitchListTile(
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        title: Text(ct(c, en, th)),
        value: values[field] as bool,
        onChanged: (v) => onChanged(field, v),
      );
  Widget _checks(
    BuildContext c,
    String field,
    String en,
    String th,
    Map<String, String> options,
  ) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      Text(ct(c, en, th), style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.titleMedium),
      for (final entry in options.entries)
        CheckboxListTile(
          secondary: field == 'fruit_ids'
              ? Image.asset(
                  'assets/images/games/basket/fruits/${entry.key}.png',
                  width: 48,
                  height: 48,
                )
              : null,
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          title: Text(entry.value),
          value: (values[field] as List).contains(entry.key),
          onChanged: (yes) {
            final list = List<String>.from(values[field] as List);
            if (yes == true) {
              list.add(entry.key);
            } else {
              list.remove(entry.key);
            }
            onChanged(field, list);
          },
        ),
    ],
  );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const levels = ['child_choice', 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'];
    final fields = <Widget>[];
    switch (game) {
      case CaretakerGame.socialChat:
        fields.addAll([
          _select(context, 'input_mode', 'Input method', 'วิธีป้อนข้อความ', [

          _select(
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image/image.dart' as img;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../../../core/audy_theme.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart';
import '../../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../caretaker_ui.dart';

String? normalizeCardImage(Uint8List bytes) {
  final decoded = img.decodeImage(bytes);
  if (decoded == null) return null;
  final oriented = img.bakeOrientation(decoded);
  final resized = img.copyResize(
    oriented,
    width: oriented.width >= oriented.height ? min(400, oriented.width) : null,
    height: oriented.height > oriented.width ? min(400, oriented.height) : null,
  );
  final data = img.encodeJpg(resized, quality: 70);
  if (data.length > 131072) return null;
  return 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(data)}';
}

class CustomCardsEditor extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomCardsEditor({
    super.key,
    required this.cards,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onPendingChanged,
  });
  final List<dynamic> cards;
  final ValueChanged<List<dynamic>> onChanged;
  final ValueChanged<bool> onPendingChanged;
  @override
  State<CustomCardsEditor> createState() => _CustomCardsEditorState();
}

class _CustomCardsEditorState extends State<CustomCardsEditor> {
  final _word = TextEditingController();
  String _category = 'noun';
  String? _image;
  String? _editingId;
  String? _message;
  bool _error = false;
  bool _busy = false;

  static const _types = [
    ('pronoun', 'Pronouns', 'สรรพนาม', AudyColors.skyBlue),
    ('noun', 'Noun', 'คำนาม', AudyColors.mintGreen),
    ('verb', 'Actions', 'การกระทำ', Colors.orange),
    ('adjective', 'Feeling', 'ความรู้สึก', AudyColors.blushPink),
    ('adverb', 'Adverbs', 'คำวิเศษณ์', AudyColors.softLavender),
  ];

  void _pending() => widget.onPendingChanged(
    _word.text.isNotEmpty ||
        _image != null ||
        _category != 'noun' ||
        _editingId != null ||
        _busy,
  );

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _word.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _clear() {
    _word.clear();
    _category = 'noun';
    _image = null;
    _editingId = null;
  }

  Future<void> _edit(Map<String, dynamic> card) async {
    final pending =
        _word.text.isNotEmpty ||
        _image != null ||
        _category != 'noun' ||
        _editingId != null;
    if (pending) {
      final discard = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'Replace unfinished card?',
              'แทนที่บัตรที่ยังไม่เสร็จหรือไม่?',
            ),
          ),
          content: Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'The text and picture in the form have not been added.',
              'ข้อความและรูปในแบบฟอร์มยังไม่ได้เพิ่มลงในคลัง',
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(ct(context, 'Keep editing', 'แก้ไขต่อ')),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              child: Text(ct(context, 'Replace', 'แทนที่')),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      if (discard != true || !mounted) return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _word.text = card['word'] as String;
      _category = card['category'] as String? ?? 'noun';
      _image = card['image_url'] as String?;
      _editingId = card['id'] as String?;
      _message = null;
    });
    _pending();
    if (mounted) {
      await Scrollable.ensureVisible(
        context,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickImage() async {
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    _pending();
    try {
      final file = await ImagePicker().pickImage(
        source: ImageSource.gallery,
        maxWidth: 400,
        maxHeight: 400,
        imageQuality: 70,
      );
      if (file == null) return;
      final image = await compute(normalizeCardImage, await file.readAsBytes());
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (image != null) _image = image;
        _error = image == null;
        _message = image == null
            ? ct(
                context,
                'Could not use this picture. Choose a smaller JPEG or PNG.',
                'ใช้รูปนี้ไม่ได้ กรุณาเลือกรูป JPEG หรือ PNG ที่เล็กลง',
              )
            : null;
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = true;
          _message = ct(
            context,
            'Could not open the picture. Please try again.',
            'เปิดรูปไม่ได้ กรุณาลองอีกครั้ง',
          );
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _busy = false);
        _pending();
      }
    }
  }

  void _addCard() {
    final word = _word.text.trim();
    String? error;
    if (word.isEmpty || word.length > 40) {
      error = ct(
        context,
        'Please enter a word (1–40 characters).',
        'กรุณากรอกคำ 1–40 ตัวอักษร',
      );
    } else if (widget.cards.any(
      (card) =>
          card['id'] != _editingId &&
          card['category'] == _category &&
          card['word'].toString().trim().toLowerCase() == word.toLowerCase(),
    )) {
      error = ct(
        context,
        'This word and word type are already in the library.',
        'มีคำและประเภทคำนี้ในคลังแล้ว',
      );
    } else if (_editingId == null && widget.cards.length >= 20) {
      error = ct(
        context,
        'Use up to 20 custom cards for each child.',
        'ใช้บัตรคำได้สูงสุด 20 ใบต่อเด็กหนึ่งคน',
      );
    }
    if (error != null) {
      setState(() {
        _error = true;
        _message = error;
      });
      return;
    }
    final card = {
      'id':
          _editingId ??
          List.generate(
            16,
            (_) =>
                Random.secure().nextInt(256).toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'),
          ).join(),
      'word': word,
      'category': _category,
      'image_url': _image,
    };
    final updated = List<dynamic>.from(widget.cards);
    final index = updated.indexWhere((card) => card['id'] == _editingId);
    if (index < 0) {
      updated.add(card);
    } else {
      updated[index] = card;
    }
    widget.onChanged(updated);
    setState(() {
      _clear();
      _error = false;
      _message = ct(
        context,
        'Added "$word" to this draft. Use Save settings to keep it.',
        'เพิ่ม "$word" ในฉบับแก้ไขแล้ว กดบันทึกการตั้งค่าเพื่อจัดเก็บ',
      );
    });
    _pending();
  }

  Future<void> _import() async {
    final ownerId = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    _pending();
    try {
      final words = await CaretakerRepository(
        Supabase.instance.client,
      ).legacyWords();
      if (!mounted || AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id != ownerId) return;
      final index = await showDialog<int>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => SimpleDialog(
          title: Text(ct(context, 'Import a legacy card', 'นำเข้าบัตรเดิม')),
          children: [
            if (words.isEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text(
                  ct(context, 'No legacy cards found.', 'ไม่พบบัตรเดิม'),
                ),
              ),
            for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++)
              SimpleDialogOption(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, i),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  child: Text(
                    '${words[i].word} · ${words[i].category ?? 'noun'}',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
      if (index != null &&
          mounted &&
          AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id == ownerId) {
        final word = words[index];
        await _edit({
          'word': word.word,
          'category': word.category ?? 'noun',
          'image_url': word.imageUrl,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = true;
          _message = caretakerError(error);
        });
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _busy = false);
        _pending();
      }
    }
  }

  InputDecoration _decoration(String label, IconData icon, {String? hint}) =>
      InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        hintText: hint,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: AudyColors.backgroundSoft.withValues(alpha: .1),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AudySpacing.radiusMedium),
        ),
      );

  Widget _library() => LayoutBuilder(
    builder: (context, constraints) => Wrap(
      spacing: 10,
      runSpacing: 10,
      children: [
        for (final entry in widget.cards)
          _cardChip(
            Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry as Map),
            constraints.maxWidth,
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  Widget _cardChip(Map<String, dynamic> card, double width) {
    final type = _types.firstWhere((type) => type.$1 == card['category']);
    return InputChip(
      avatar: card['image_url'] == null
          ? null
          : ClipOval(
              child: CardPicture(card['image_url'] as String?, size: 24),
            ),
      label: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          minHeight: 48,
          maxWidth: max(48, min(260, width - 112)),
        ),
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: 6,
          runSpacing: 4,
          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Text(
              card['word'] as String,
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 13),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: type.$4,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
              ),
              child: Text(
                ct(context, type.$2, type.$3),
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: AudyColors.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      tooltip: ct(context, 'Edit card', 'แก้ไขบัตร'),
      materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.padded,
      avatarBoxConstraints: const BoxConstraints.tightFor(
        width: 24,
        height: 24,
      ),
      deleteIconBoxConstraints: const BoxConstraints.tightFor(
        width: 48,
        height: 48,
      ),
      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _edit(card),
      onDeleted: _busy
          ? null
          : () {
              widget.onChanged(
                List<dynamic>.from(widget.cards)
                  ..removeWhere((entry) => entry['id'] == card['id']),
              );
              if (_editingId == card['id']) {
                setState(_clear);
                _pending();
              }
            },
      deleteButtonTooltipMessage: ct(context, 'Remove card', 'ลบบัตร'),
      backgroundColor: AudyColors.backgroundSoft.withValues(alpha: .15),
      side: const BorderSide(color: AudyColors.borderLight, width: 1.2),
    );
  }

class CardPicture extends StatelessWidget {
  const CardPicture(this.source, {super.key, this.size = 100});
  final String? source;
  final double size;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Widget fallback() => Icon(Icons.style_outlined, size: size / 2);
    final value = source;
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return SizedBox(width: size, height: size, child: fallback());
    }
    if (value.startsWith('emoji:')) {
      return SizedBox(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            value.substring(6),
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: size * .5),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (value.startsWith('data:image/')) {
      try {
        return Image.memory(
          base64Decode(value.split(',').last),
          width: size,
          height: size,
          cacheWidth: 400,
          fit: BoxFit.contain,
          errorBuilder: (_, e, s) => fallback(),
        );
      } catch (_) {
        return fallback();
      }
    }
    if (value.startsWith('assets/')) {
      return Image.asset(
        value,
        width: size,
        height: size,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
        errorBuilder: (_, e, s) => fallback(),
      );
    }
    return fallback();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import '../caretaker_ui.dart';
import 'game_editor.dart';
import 'break_settings_editor.dart';

class CustomizationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomizationPage({super.key, required this.controller});
  final CaretakerController controller;
  @override
  State<CustomizationPage> createState() => _CustomizationPageState();
}

class _CustomizationPageState extends State<CustomizationPage> {
  final _repository = GameConfigurationRepository(Supabase.instance.client);
  Set<String> _saved = {};
  String? _error;
  bool _loading = true;
  int _request = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.controller.addListener(_changed);
    _load();
  }

  String? _child;
  void _changed() {
    if (_child != widget.controller.selectedId) _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    _child = widget.controller.selectedId;
    final request = ++_request;
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
      _saved = {};
    });
    try {
      final saved = _child == null
          ? <String>{}
          : await _repository.summaries(_child!);
      if (mounted && request == _request) setState(() => _saved = saved);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted && request == _request) {
        setState(() => _error = caretakerError(e));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted && request == _request) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_changed);
    _request++;
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CaretakerAccountGuard(
    child: Scaffold(

              subtitle: Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Set the number of games before a break. Applies to Student play.',
                  'กำหนดจำนวนเกมก่อนพัก ใช้กับการเล่นของเด็ก',
                ),
              ),
              trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
              enabled:

                  !widget.controller.loading &&

                context,

                ),
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 32),
            Text(
              ct(context, 'Game previews', 'การทดลองเกม'),
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
            ),
            CaretakerNotice(
              ct(
                context,
                'Saved settings are for Caretaker previews. Student gameplay is unchanged in this phase.',
                'การตั้งค่าใช้ในการทดลองของผู้ดูแล เกมของเด็กยังใช้การตั้งค่าเดิมในระยะนี้',
              ),
            ),
            if (_loading) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
            if (_error != null) CaretakerNotice(_error!, onRetry: _load),
            for (final game in CaretakerGame.values)
              ListTile(
                minVerticalPadding: 16,
                leading: const Icon(Icons.sports_esports_outlined),
                title: Text(game.title),
                subtitle: Text(
                  _loading || _error != null
                      ? ct(
                          context,
                          'Settings not loaded',
```
