```dart
                      : ct(
                          context,
                          _saved.contains(game.key)
                              ? 'Customized'
                              : 'Default settings',
                          _saved.contains(game.key)
                              ? 'ปรับแต่งแล้ว'
                              : 'ค่าเริ่มต้น',
                        ),
                ),
                trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                enabled:
                    widget.controller.selected != null &&
                    !_loading &&
                    _error == null,
                onTap: () async {
                  final child = widget.controller.selected!;
                  await Navigator.push(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                      builder: (_) => GameEditor(
                        child: child,
                        game: game,
                        repository: _repository,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                  if (mounted) _load();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

## lib/src/features/caretaker/customization/game_editor.dart
```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../../data/models/game_configuration.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart';
import '../../../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../caretaker_ui.dart';
import 'configuration_form.dart';
import 'custom_cards_editor.dart';
import 'game_preview.dart';

class GameEditor extends StatefulWidget {
  const GameEditor({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.game,
    required this.repository,
  });
  final UserProfile child;
  final CaretakerGame game;
  final GameConfigurationRepository repository;
  @override
  State<GameEditor> createState() => _GameEditorState();
}

class _GameEditorState extends State<GameEditor> {
  SavedGameConfiguration? _saved;
  Map<String, dynamic>? _draft;
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _uncertain = false;
  bool _conflict = false;
  int _formRevision = 0;
  int _cardsRevision = 0;
  bool _pendingCard = false;
  String? _ownerId;
  bool _started = false;
  bool get _sessionActive =>
      mounted && AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id == _ownerId;
  bool get _dirty =>
      _pendingCard ||
      (_draft != null &&
          jsonEncode(_draft) != jsonEncode(_saved!.config.toJson()));
  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (!_started) {
      _started = true;
      _ownerId = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id;
      _load();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      final saved = await widget.repository.load(widget.child.id, widget.game);
      if (_sessionActive) {
        setState(() {
          _saved = saved;
          _draft = saved.config.toJson();
          _error = saved.editable
              ? null
              : ct(
                  context,
                  'Update the app to edit these settings.',
                  'อัปเดตแอปเพื่อแก้ไขการตั้งค่านี้',
                );
          _uncertain = false;
          _conflict = false;
          _formRevision++;
          _cardsRevision++;
          _pendingCard = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = caretakerError(e));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _save() async {
    if (!_cardReady()) return false;
    final config = GameConfiguration(widget.game, _draft!);
    final errors = config.validate();
    if (errors.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() => _error = errors.join('\n'));
      return false;
    }
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final saved = await widget.repository.save(
        widget.child.id,
        config,
        _saved!.revision,
      );
      if (!mounted || !_sessionActive) return false;
      setState(() {
        _saved = saved;
        _draft = saved.config.toJson();
      });
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'Saved for ${widget.child.name}. Student gameplay is unchanged.',
              'บันทึกสำหรับ ${widget.child.name} แล้ว เกมของเด็กยังใช้ค่าเดิม',
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = caretakerError(e);
          _conflict =
              e.toString().contains('40001') ||
              e.toString().contains('revision');
          _uncertain = !_conflict;
        });
      }
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  bool _cardReady() {
    if (!_pendingCard) return true;
    setState(
      () => _error = ct(
        context,
        'Add or update your unfinished card, or clear the card form, before saving or previewing.',
        'กรุณาเพิ่มหรืออัปเดตบัตรที่ยังไม่เสร็จ หรือล้างแบบฟอร์ม ก่อนบันทึกหรือทดลอง',
      ),
    );
    return false;
  }

  Future<void> _back() async {
    if (_busy) return;
    if (!_dirty ||
        await confirmLeave(
          context,
          () => _uncertain || _conflict ? Future.value(false) : _save(),
        )) {
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  void _change(String field, dynamic value) => setState(() {
    _draft![field] = field == 'duration_seconds' && value == -1 ? null : value;
    _error = null;
  });
  Future<void> _reload() async {
    if (_dirty &&
        !await confirmLeave(
          context,
          () => _uncertain || _conflict ? Future.value(false) : _save(),
        )) {
      return;
    }
    if (mounted) await _load();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final editable = _saved?.editable == true;
    return CaretakerAccountGuard(
      child: PopScope(
        canPop: !_dirty && !_busy,
        onPopInvokedWithResult: (p, r) {
          if (!p) _back();
        },
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            leading: IconButton(
              onPressed: _back,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back),
              tooltip: ct(context, 'Back', 'กลับ'),
            ),
            title: Text('${widget.child.name} · ${widget.game.title}'),
          ),
          body: CaretakerPageBody(
            children: [
              CaretakerNotice(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Caretaker preview settings. Student games keep their current behavior.',
                  'ตั้งค่าสำหรับการทดลองของผู้ดูแล เกมของเด็กยังใช้พฤติกรรมเดิม',
                ),
              ),
              if (_busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
              if (_error != null)
                CaretakerNotice(_error!, onRetry: _busy ? null : _reload),
              if (_draft != null && editable)
                IgnorePointer(
                  ignoring: _busy || !editable,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      if (widget.game == CaretakerGame.flashcard) ...[
                        CustomCardsEditor(
                          key: ValueKey('${widget.child.id}-$_cardsRevision'),
                          cards: _draft!['custom_cards'] as List,
                          onChanged: (cards) => _change('custom_cards', cards),
                          onPendingChanged: (pending) => setState(() {
                            _pendingCard = pending;
                            _error = null;
                          }),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 24),
                      ],
                      ConfigurationForm(
                        key: ValueKey(_formRevision),
                        game: widget.game,
                        values: {
                          ..._draft!,
                          if (widget.game == CaretakerGame.fruitCatch &&
                              _draft!['duration_seconds'] == null)
                            'duration_seconds': -1,
                        },
                        onChanged: _change,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              if (editable) ...[
                FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _busy || _uncertain || _conflict ? null : _save,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.save_outlined),
                  label: Text(ct(context, 'Save settings', 'บันทึกการตั้งค่า')),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _busy
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          if (!_cardReady()) return;
                          final config = GameConfiguration(
                            widget.game,
                            _draft!,
                          );
                          final errors = config.validate();
                          if (errors.isNotEmpty) {
                            setState(() => _error = errors.join('\n'));
                            return;
                          }
                          Navigator.push(
                            context,
                            MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                              builder: (_) => GamePreview(
                                config: config,
                                childName: widget.child.name,
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow),
                  label: Text(ct(context, 'Preview draft', 'ทดลองการตั้งค่า')),
                ),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: _busy
                      ? null
                      : () => setState(() {
                          final cards = _draft!['custom_cards'];
                          _draft = GameConfiguration.defaults(
                            widget.game,
                          ).toJson();
                          if (cards != null) _draft!['custom_cards'] = cards;
                          _formRevision++;
                        }),
                  child: Text(
                    ct(context, 'Restore defaults', 'คืนค่าเริ่มต้น'),
                  ),
                ),
                if (_conflict || _uncertain)
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: _busy
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            // Reload first after an uncertain write; never replay a possibly committed save.
                            final keep = Map<String, dynamic>.from(_draft!);
                            await _load();
                            if (mounted && _saved != null && !_busy) {
                              setState(() => _draft = keep);
                            }
                          },
                    child: Text(
                      ct(
                        context,
                        'Reload saved revision and keep my draft',
                        'โหลดรุ่นล่าสุดและเก็บฉบับแก้ไขของฉัน',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## lib/src/features/caretaker/customization/previews/emotion_preview.dart
```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../../../core/emotion_images.dart';
import '../../caretaker_ui.dart';

class EmotionPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const EmotionPreview({super.key, required this.values});
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  @override
  State<EmotionPreview> createState() => _EmotionPreviewState();
}

class _EmotionPreviewState extends State<EmotionPreview> {
  final _random = Random();
  late List<String> _targets;
  late List<String> _choices;
  late String _image;
  int _round = 0;
  String? _answer;
  bool _selfie = false;
  Timer? _timer;
  String get _target => _targets[_round];
  String _title(String s) => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.substring(1);
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final pool = List<String>.from(widget.values['target_emotions'] as List);
    _targets = [];
    while (_targets.length < (widget.values['round_count'] as int)) {
      final cycle = List<String>.from(pool)..shuffle(_random);
      if (_targets.isNotEmpty && cycle.first == _targets.last) {
        cycle.add(cycle.removeAt(0));
      }
      _targets.addAll(cycle);
    }
    _prepare();
  }

  void _prepare() {
    final others = List<String>.from(widget.values['target_emotions'] as List)
      ..remove(_target)
      ..shuffle(_random);
    final selected = {
      _target,
      ...others.take((widget.values['choice_count'] as int) - 1),
    };
    _choices = [
      'happy',
      'sad',
      'angry',
      'scared',
    ].where(selected.contains).toList();
    _image = widget.values['image_mode'] == 'consistent'
        ? EmotionImages.getDefaultPath(_title(_target))
        : EmotionImages.getRandomPath(_title(_target));
  }

  void _choose(String answer) {
    setState(() => _answer = answer);
    final mode = widget.values['advance_mode'];
    if (mode != 'manual') {
      _timer = Timer(
        Duration(milliseconds: mode == 'automatic_3000ms' ? 3000 : 1500),
        () {
          if (mounted) setState(() => _selfie = true);
        },
      );
    }
  }

  void _next() {
    setState(() {
      _round++;
      _answer = null;
      _selfie = false;
      if (_round < (widget.values['round_count'] as int)) _prepare();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_round >= (widget.values['round_count'] as int)) {
      return Center(
        child: Text(ct(context, 'Preview complete', 'ทดลองเสร็จแล้ว')),
      );
    }
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      children: [
        Text(
          ct(
            context,
            'Round ${_round + 1}/${widget.values['round_count']}',
            'รอบ ${_round + 1}/${widget.values['round_count']}',
          ),
        ),
        if (widget.values['show_guide'] == true)
          CaretakerNotice(
            ct(
              context,
              'Choose the matching emotion, then see the selfie target. Camera recognition is not tested here.',
              'เลือกอารมณ์ที่ตรงกัน แล้วดูเป้าหมายเซลฟี หน้านี้ไม่ทดสอบกล้องหรือโมเดล',
            ),
          ),
        if (_selfie) ...[
          const Icon(Icons.camera_alt_outlined, size: 80),
          Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'Next: make a ${_title(_target)} face',
              'ขั้นต่อไป: แสดงสีหน้า ${_title(_target)}',
            ),
          ),
          CaretakerNotice(
            ct(
              context,
              'Selfie target preview only. No photo or model result is created.',
              'แสดงเป้าหมายเท่านั้น ไม่ถ่ายภาพหรือสร้างผลตรวจ',
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: _next,
            child: Text(ct(context, 'Next preview round', 'รอบทดลองถัดไป')),
          ),
        ] else ...[
          Image.asset(_image, height: 220, fit: BoxFit.contain),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          for (final emotion in _choices)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
              child: OutlinedButton(
                onPressed: _answer == null ? () => _choose(emotion) : null,
                child: Text(_title(emotion)),
              ),
            ),
          if (_answer != null)
            Text(
              _answer == _target
                  ? ct(context, 'Well done!', 'เก่งมาก!')
                  : ct(
                      context,
                      'The matching emotion is ${_title(_target)}.',
                      'อารมณ์ที่ตรงคือ ${_title(_target)}',
                    ),
            ),
          if (_answer != null && widget.values['advance_mode'] == 'manual')
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => setState(() => _selfie = true),
              child: Text(
                ct(context, 'Continue to selfie target', 'ดูเป้าหมายเซลฟี'),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## lib/src/features/caretaker/customization/previews/flashcard_preview.dart
```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';
import '../../../flashcard/flashcard_api_service.dart';
import '../../../flashcard/flashcard_controller.dart';
import '../../../flashcard/flashcard_models.dart';
import '../../../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../../caretaker_ui.dart';
import '../custom_cards_editor.dart';

class _PreviewApi extends FlashcardApiService {
  _PreviewApi(this.cards);
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards;
  @override
  Future<FlashcardRound> generateRound({
    required String language,
    required int wordCount,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>>? customCards,
  }) => super.generateRound(
    language: language,
    wordCount: wordCount,
    customCards: cards,
  );
  @override
  Future<FlashcardValidation> validateRound({
    required String roundId,
    required String language,
    required List<String> targetCardIds,
    required List<String> selectedCardIds,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>>? customCards,
  }) => super.validateRound(
    roundId: roundId,
    language: language,
    targetCardIds: targetCardIds,
    selectedCardIds: selectedCardIds,
    customCards: cards,
  );
}

class FlashcardPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const FlashcardPreview({super.key, required this.values});
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  @override
  State<FlashcardPreview> createState() => _FlashcardPreviewState();
}

class _FlashcardPreviewState extends State<FlashcardPreview> {
  FlashcardController? _controller;
  final _tts = FlutterTts();
  Timer? _timer;
  String _difficulty = 'easy';
  String? _spoken;
  bool _submitting = false;
  String get _language => widget.values['language'] == 'app'
      ? AudyScope.of(context).currentLanguage
      : widget.values['language'] as String;
  Future<void> _speak(String text) async {
    await _tts.setLanguage(_language == 'th' ? 'th-TH' : 'en-US');
    await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.42);
    await _tts.speak(text);
  }

  void _start() {
    final level = widget.values['difficulty'] == 'child_choice'
        ? _difficulty
        : widget.values['difficulty'] as String;
    final cards = widget.values['use_custom_cards'] == true
        ? (widget.values['custom_cards'] as List)
              .map((c) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(c as Map))
              .toList()
        : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final c = FlashcardController(
      difficulty: FlashcardDifficulty.values.byName(level),
      api: _PreviewApi(cards),
    );
    _controller = c;
    c.addListener(_changed);
    c.startSession(_language);
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _changed() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {});
    _timer?.cancel();
    final c = _controller!;
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.previewing) {
      final card = c.previewCard;
      final key = '${c.currentRound?.roundId}:${c.previewIndex}';
      if (card != null && _spoken != key) {
        _spoken = key;
        if (widget.values['auto_speak'] == true) {
          unawaited(_speak(card.ttsText));
        }
      }
      final pace = widget.values['preview_pace'];
      if (pace != 'manual') {
        _timer = Timer(
          Duration(seconds: int.parse(pace.toString().split('_').first)),
          c.advancePreview,
        );
      }
    }
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.feedback) {
      _timer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 1400), () {
        if (mounted) c.continueAfterFeedback();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _tts.stop();
    _controller?.removeListener(_changed);
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget _card(FlashcardCard card, {VoidCallback? tap}) => SizedBox(
    width: 150,
    child: Card(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: tap,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              CardPicture(card.imageAsset, size: 80),
              Text(card.displayText),
              IconButton(
                tooltip: ct(context, 'Speak', 'อ่านออกเสียง'),
                onPressed: () => _speak(card.ttsText),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = _controller;
    if (c == null) {
      return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        children: [
          if (widget.values['difficulty'] == 'child_choice')
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _difficulty,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: ct(context, 'Preview difficulty', 'ระดับทดลอง'),
              ),
              items: [
                for (final level in ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'])
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: level, child: Text(level)),
              ],
              onChanged: (v) => _difficulty = v!,
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: _start,
            child: Text(
              ct(context, 'Generate preview sentence', 'สร้างประโยคทดลอง'),
            ),
          ),
          CaretakerNotice(
            ct(
              context,
              'Custom words join the pool; a sentence may use only some of them.',
              'คำที่เพิ่มเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของคลัง แต่ละประโยคอาจเลือกใช้บางคำ',
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.loading ||
        c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.validating) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.error) {
      return Center(
        child: CaretakerNotice(
          ct(
            context,
            'Could not load the sentence. Please retry.',
            'โหลดประโยคไม่ได้ กรุณาลองอีกครั้ง',
          ),
          onRetry: () => c.retry(_language),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.complete) {
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          ct(context, 'Three-round preview complete.', 'ทดลองครบสามรอบแล้ว'),
        ),
      );
    }
    if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.previewing) {
      final card = c.previewCard;
      return Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (card != null) _card(card),
              if (widget.values['preview_pace'] == 'manual')
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: c.advancePreview,
                  child: Text(ct(context, 'Next card', 'บัตรถัดไป')),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      children: [
        Text(
          ct(
            context,
            'Round ${c.roundNumber}/3 · Build the sentence',
            'รอบ ${c.roundNumber}/3 · เรียงประโยค',
          ),
        ),
        Text(c.currentRound?.scenario ?? ''),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: [
            for (var i = 0; i < c.cardCount; i++)
              if (i < c.selectedCards.length)
                _card(
                  c.selectedCards[i],
                  tap: c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.playing
                      ? () => c.removeSelectedCard(c.selectedCards[i])
                      : null,
                )
              else if (c.hintCardForSlot(i) != null)
                SizedBox(
                  width: 150,
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      Opacity(
                        opacity: .45,
                        child: CardPicture(
                          c.hintCardForSlot(i)!.imageAsset,
                          size: 80,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (c.difficulty.showHintWord)
                        Text(c.hintCardForSlot(i)!.displayText),
                    ],
                  ),
                )
              else
                const SizedBox(
                  width: 150,
                  height: 100,
                  child: Center(child: Icon(Icons.add_box_outlined)),
                ),
          ],
        ),
        const Divider(height: 32),
        Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: [
            for (final card in c.handCards)
              _card(
                card,
                tap: c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.playing
                    ? () => c.selectCard(card)
                    : null,
              ),
          ],
        ),
        if (c.phase == FlashcardGamePhase.feedback)
          Text(c.lastValidation?.feedback ?? ''),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: !c.canSubmit || _submitting
              ? null
              : () async {
                  setState(() => _submitting = true);
                  await c.submit();
                  if (mounted) setState(() => _submitting = false);
                },
          child: Text(ct(context, 'Check sentence', 'ตรวจประโยค')),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../caretaker_ui.dart';

class FruitPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const FruitPreview({super.key, required this.values});
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  @override
  State<FruitPreview> createState() => _FruitPreviewState();
}

class _FruitItem {
  _FruitItem(this.x, this.asset, this.bomb);
  final double x;
  final String asset;
  final bool bomb;
  double y = -.12;
}

class _FruitPreviewState extends State<FruitPreview>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final _random = Random();
  final List<_FruitItem> _items = [];
  Timer? _tick;
  Timer? _spawn;
  double _x = .25;
  double _target = .25;
  int _score = 0;
  bool _over = false;
  int _elapsedMs = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _run();
  }

  void _run() {
    _tick = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 16), (_) {
      if (!mounted || _over) return;
      setState(() {
        _elapsedMs += 16;
        _x += (_target - _x) * .25;
        final speed = switch (widget.values['fall_speed']) {
          'slow' => .0032,
          'fast' => .0064,
          _ => .0048,
        };
        for (final item in List<_FruitItem>.from(_items)) {
          item.y += speed;
          if (item.y > .78 && item.y < .94 && (item.x - _x).abs() < .16) {
            _items.remove(item);
            if (item.bomb) {
              _end();
              break;
            } else {
              _score++;
            }
          }
        }
        _items.removeWhere((item) => item.y > 1.02);
        final duration = widget.values['duration_seconds'] as int?;
        if (duration != null && _elapsedMs >= duration * 1000) _end();
      });
    });
    _spawn = Timer.periodic(
      Duration(milliseconds: widget.values['spawn_interval_ms'] as int),
      (_) {
        if (!mounted || _over) return;
        final bomb =
            _score >= (widget.values['bomb_grace_count'] as int) &&
            _random.nextDouble() <
                (widget.values['bomb_probability'] as num).toDouble();
        final fruits = widget.values['fruit_ids'] as List;
        setState(
          () => _items.add(
            _FruitItem(
              _random.nextBool() ? 0.25 : 0.75,
              bomb ? 'bomb' : fruits[_random.nextInt(fruits.length)] as String,
              bomb,
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _end() {
    _over = true;
    _tick?.cancel();
    _spawn?.cancel();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    _tick?.cancel();
    _spawn?.cancel();
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed && !_over) _run();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _tick?.cancel();
    _spawn?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(
        ct(
          context,
          'Preview score: $_score · ${_elapsedMs ~/ 1000}s',
          'คะแนนทดลอง: $_score · ${_elapsedMs ~/ 1000} วินาที',
        ),
      ),
      if (widget.values['show_guide'] == true)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Text(
            ct(
              context,
              'Tap left or right to catch fruit and avoid bombs.',
              'แตะซ้ายหรือขวาเพื่อรับผลไม้และหลบระเบิด',
            ),
          ),
        ),
      Expanded(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, size) => GestureDetector(
            onTapDown: _over
                ? null
                : (d) => setState(
                    () => _target = d.localPosition.dx < size.maxWidth / 2
                        ? 0.25
                        : 0.75,
                  ),
            child: ClipRect(
              child: Stack(
                fit: StackFit.expand,
                children: [
                  Image.asset(
                    'assets/images/games/basket/background.png',
                    fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  ),
                  for (final item in _items)
                    Positioned(
                      left: item.x * size.maxWidth - 24,
                      top: item.y * size.maxHeight,
                      child: Image.asset(
                        'assets/images/games/basket/fruits/${item.asset}.png',
                        width: 48,
                        height: 48,
                      ),
                    ),
                  Positioned(
                    left: _x * size.maxWidth - 50,
                    bottom: 8,
                    child: Image.asset(
                      'assets/images/games/basket/bear_default.png',
                      width: 100,
                      height: 100,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_over)
                    Center(
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                        color: Colors.white,
                        child: Text(
                          ct(
                            context,
                            'Preview complete · $_score fruit',
                            'ทดลองเสร็จ · $_score ผล',
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: Text(ct(context, 'End preview', 'จบการทดลอง')),
        ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../../../core/audy_ui.dart';
import '../../../minipuzzle_game/minipuzzle_controller.dart';
import '../../../minipuzzle_game/minipuzzle_models.dart';
import '../../../minipuzzle_game/games/pattern_game_widget.dart';
import '../../../minipuzzle_game/games/odd_one_out_game_widget.dart';
import '../../../minipuzzle_game/games/puzzle_game_widget.dart';
import '../../caretaker_ui.dart';

class MiniPuzzlePreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const MiniPuzzlePreview({super.key, required this.values});
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  @override
  State<MiniPuzzlePreview> createState() => _MiniPuzzlePreviewState();
}

class _MiniPuzzlePreviewState extends State<MiniPuzzlePreview> {
  final _controller = MiniPuzzleController();
  Timer? _timer;
  int? _scheduled;
  bool _started = false;
  bool _complete = false;
  late String _type = (widget.values['enabled_types'] as List).first as String;
  String _difficulty = 'easy';
  void _start() {
    final field = switch (_type) {
      'pattern' => 'pattern_difficulty',
      'oddOneOut' => 'odd_one_out_difficulty',
      _ => 'puzzle_difficulty',
    };
    final level = widget.values[field] == 'child_choice'
        ? _difficulty
        : widget.values[field] as String;
    _controller.startGame(
      MiniPuzzleType.values.byName(_type),
      MiniPuzzleDifficulty.values.byName(level),
    );
    setState(() => _started = true);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller.addListener(_changed);
  }

  void _changed() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {});
    if (!_controller.roundComplete || _scheduled == _controller.currentRound) {
      return;
    }
    _scheduled = _controller.currentRound;
    final mode = widget.values['advance_mode'];
    if (mode != 'manual') {
      _timer = Timer(
        Duration(milliseconds: mode == 'automatic_1800ms' ? 1800 : 900),
        _next,
      );
    }
  }

  void _next() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_controller.currentRound >= 3) {
      setState(() => _complete = true);
    } else {
      _controller.nextRound();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _controller.removeListener(_changed);
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!_started) {
      return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        children: [
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            initialValue: _type,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: ct(context, 'Activity', 'กิจกรรม'),
            ),
            items: [
              for (final type in widget.values['enabled_types'] as List)
                DropdownMenuItem(value: type as String, child: Text(type)),
            ],
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _type = v!),
          ),
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            initialValue: _difficulty,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: ct(
                context,
                'Preview level when child chooses',
                'ระดับทดลองเมื่อเด็กเลือกเอง',
              ),
            ),
            items: [
              for (final level in ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'])
                DropdownMenuItem(value: level, child: Text(level)),
            ],
            onChanged: (v) => _difficulty = v!,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: _start,
            child: Text(ct(context, 'Start preview', 'เริ่มทดลอง')),
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
    if (_complete) {
      return Center(
        child: Text(
          ct(
            context,
            'Preview complete · ${_controller.totalCorrect}/3',
            'ทดลองเสร็จ · ${_controller.totalCorrect}/3',
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final adaptive = AudyAdaptive(width: size.width, height: size.height);
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      children: [
        if (widget.values['show_guide'] == true)
          CaretakerNotice(
            ct(
              context,
              'Choose the next pattern, the different item, or match each piece to its slot.',
              'เลือกแบบรูปถัดไป สิ่งที่แตกต่าง หรือจับคู่ชิ้นส่วน',
            ),
          ),
        Text(
          ct(
            context,
            'Round ${_controller.currentRound}/3',
            'รอบ ${_controller.currentRound}/3',
          ),
        ),
        switch (_type) {
          'pattern' => PatternGameWidget(
            controller: _controller,
            adaptive: adaptive,
            gameColor: Colors.blue,
          ),
          'oddOneOut' => OddOneOutGameWidget(
            controller: _controller,
            adaptive: adaptive,
            gameColor: Colors.pink,
          ),
          _ => PuzzleGameWidget(
            controller: _controller,
            adaptive: adaptive,
            gameColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        },
        if (_controller.showingFeedback)
          Text(
            _controller.isCorrect
                ? ct(context, 'Well done!', 'เก่งมาก!')
                : ct(context, 'Try again', 'ลองอีกครั้ง'),
          ),
        if (_controller.roundComplete &&
            widget.values['advance_mode'] == 'manual')
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: _next,
            child: Text(ct(context, 'Next', 'ถัดไป')),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';
import 'package:speech_to_text/speech_to_text.dart';
import '../../../social_chat/chat_service.dart';
import '../../caretaker_ui.dart';

class SocialPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  const SocialPreview({super.key, required this.values});
  final Map<String, dynamic> values;
  @override
  State<SocialPreview> createState() => _SocialPreviewState();
}

class _SocialPreviewState extends State<SocialPreview> {
  final _chat = ChatService();
  final _speech = SpeechToText();
  final _tts = FlutterTts();
  final _text = TextEditingController();
  final List<(bool, String)> _messages = [];
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _listening = false;
  String? _error;
  Future<void> _speak(String text) async {
    await _tts.setLanguage('th-TH');
    await _tts.speak(text);
  }

  Future<void> _listen() async {
    if (_listening) {
      await _speech.stop();
      if (mounted) setState(() => _listening = false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final available = await _speech.initialize(
        onStatus: (s) {
          if (mounted && (s == 'done' || s == 'notListening')) {
            setState(() => _listening = false);
          }
        },
        onError: (_) {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _listening = false;
              _error = ct(
                context,
                'Microphone unavailable. You can type instead.',
                'ใช้ไมโครโฟนไม่ได้ สามารถพิมพ์แทนได้',
              );
            });
          }
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (!available) {
        setState(
          () => _error = ct(
            context,
            'Microphone unavailable. You can type instead.',
            'ใช้ไมโครโฟนไม่ได้ สามารถพิมพ์แทนได้',
          ),
        );
        return;
      }
      setState(() => _listening = true);
      await _speech.listen(
        localeId: 'th_TH',
        listenFor: Duration(seconds: widget.values['listen_seconds'] as int),
        pauseFor: Duration(seconds: widget.values['pause_seconds'] as int),
        onResult: (r) {
          if (mounted) _text.text = r.recognizedWords;
        },
      );
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => _error = ct(
            context,
            'Please type your message instead.',
            'กรุณาพิมพ์ข้อความแทน',
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _send() async {
    final text = _text.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || text.length > 200) {
      setState(
        () => _error = ct(
          context,
          'Enter 1–200 characters.',
          'กรอกข้อความ 1–200 ตัวอักษร',
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    await _speech.stop();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _listening = false;
      _error = null;
      _messages.add((true, text));
      _text.clear();
    });
    try {
      final reply = await _chat
          .sendMessage(text)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _messages.add((false, reply.response)));
      if (widget.values['reply_speech'] == 'automatic') {
        await _speak(reply.response);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => _error = ct(
            context,
            'Could not get a reply. Type or send again to retry.',
            'รับคำตอบไม่ได้ ลองส่งข้อความอีกครั้ง',
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_speech.isListening) _speech.cancel();
    _tts.stop();
    _text.dispose();
    _chat.clearSession();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Expanded(
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          children: [
            CaretakerNotice(
              ct(
                context,
                'Practice a Thai conversation. Messages stay in this preview.',
                'ทดลองสนทนาภาษาไทย ข้อความอยู่เฉพาะการทดลองนี้',
              ),
            ),
            for (final message in _messages)
              ListTile(
                title: Text(message.$2),
                leading: Icon(
                  message.$1 ? Icons.person : Icons.chat_bubble_outline,
                ),
                trailing: message.$1
                    ? null
                    : IconButton(
                        onPressed: () => _speak(message.$2),
                        tooltip: ct(context, 'Speak', 'อ่านออกเสียง'),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
                      ),
              ),
            for (final phrase in widget.values['starter_phrases'] as List)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                child: OutlinedButton(
                  onPressed: () => _text.text = phrase as String,
                  child: Text(phrase),
                ),
              ),
            if (_error != null) CaretakerNotice(_error!),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      if (_busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: _text,
              maxLength: 200,
              enabled: !_busy,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: ct(context, 'Message in Thai', 'ข้อความภาษาไทย'),
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            Row(
              children: [
                if (widget.values['input_mode'] == 'text_and_voice')
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: _busy ? null : _listen,
                    tooltip: ct(context, 'Microphone', 'ไมโครโฟน'),
                    icon: Icon(_listening ? Icons.stop : Icons.mic),
                  ),
                Expanded(
                  child: FilledButton(
                    onPressed: _busy ? null : _send,
                    child: Text(ct(context, 'Send', 'ส่ง')),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}
```

## lib/src/services/auth_service.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'web_stats_sync.dart';

import '../data/models/game_session_model.dart';
import '../data/models/parent_portal_model.dart';

enum AppMode { child, caretaker, unknown }

/// User profile model stored in Supabase profiles table
class UserProfile {
  const UserProfile({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.age,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.role,
    this.email,
    this.parentId,
    this.teacherId,
  });

  final String id;
  final String name;
  final int age;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final String role; // 'child', 'parent', 'teacher'
  final String? email;
  final String? parentId;
  final String? teacherId;

  AppMode get mode => switch (role) {
    'child' => AppMode.child,
    'parent' || 'teacher' || 'caretaker' => AppMode.caretaker,
    _ => AppMode.unknown,
  };

  factory UserProfile.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return UserProfile(
      id: json['id'] as String,
      name: json['name'] as String,
      age: json['age'] as int,
      createdAt: DateTime.parse(json['created_at'] as String),
      role: json['role'] as String? ?? 'child',
      email: json['email'] as String?,
      parentId: json['parent_id'] as String?,
      teacherId: json['teacher_id'] as String?,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'name': name,
      'age': age,
      'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      'role': role,
      'email': email,
      'parent_id': parentId,
      'teacher_id': teacherId,
    };
  }
}

/// Auth service wrapping Supabase auth operations
/// Provides sign in, sign up, sign out, and profile management
class AuthService {
  final _client = Supabase.instance.client;

  /// Get the current authenticated user (or null if not logged in)
  User? get currentUser => _client.auth.currentUser;

  /// Check if user is currently logged in
  bool get isLoggedIn => currentUser != null;

  /// Stream of auth state changes
  Stream<AuthState> get authStateStream => _client.auth.onAuthStateChange;

  /// Sign in with email and password
  /// Returns the User on success, throws exception on failure
  Future<User> signIn({required String email, required String password}) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client.auth.signInWithPassword(
        email: email.trim(),
        password: password,
      );

      if (response.user == null) {
        throw Exception(
          'Sign in failed. Please check your email and password.',
        );
      }

      return response.user!;
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      throw Exception(_getFriendlyErrorMessage(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Sign in failed. Please try again.');
    }
  }

  /// Sign up with email, password, name, age, and role
  /// Profile row is created automatically by database trigger
  Future<User> signUp({
    required String email,
    required String password,
    required String name,
    required int age,
    required String role,
  }) async {
    try {
      // Create auth user with profile data in metadata
      // The database trigger will read this and create the profile row
      final response = await _client.auth.signUp(
        email: email.trim(),
        password: password,
        data: {'name': name.trim(), 'age': age, 'role': role},
      );

      if (response.user == null) {
        throw Exception('Sign up failed. Please try again.');
      }

      // Profile is created automatically by the database trigger
      // handle_new_user() reads raw_user_meta_data and inserts into profiles
      return response.user!;
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      throw Exception(_getFriendlyErrorMessage(e.message));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Sign up error: $e');
      throw Exception('Sign up failed. Please try again.');
    }
  }

  /// Sign out the current user
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    try {
      await _client.auth.signOut();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Sign out error: $e');
      // Still proceed even if there's an error
    }
  }

  /// Fetch the profile for a given user ID
  /// Returns null if profile not found
  Future<UserProfile?> fetchProfile(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('profiles')
          .select()
          .eq('id', userId)
          .single();

      return UserProfile.fromJson(response);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Fetch profile error: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Get current user's profile (convenience method)
  Future<UserProfile?> getCurrentProfile() async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) return null;
    return fetchProfile(user.id);
  }

  /// Update user profile
  Future<void> updateProfile({String? name, int? age}) async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) throw Exception('Not logged in');

    final updates = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (name != null) updates['name'] = name.trim();
    if (age != null) updates['age'] = age;

    if (updates.isNotEmpty) {
      await _client.from('profiles').update(updates).eq('id', user.id);
    }
  }

  /// Link a child to a parent by child's email.
  ///
  /// Uses the `link_child_by_email` SECURITY DEFINER RPC: profiles RLS only
  /// lets a user read/update their own row, so the parent cannot look up or
  /// update the child's row directly. The RPC does the role-checked update.
  Future<void> linkChildToParent(String parentId, String childEmail) async {
    try {
      await _client.rpc(
        'link_child_by_email',
        params: {'child_email': childEmail.trim()},
      );
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('linkChildToParent error: ${e.message}');
      throw Exception(e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('linkChildToParent error: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Link a student to a teacher by student's email.
  ///
  /// Uses the `link_student_by_email` SECURITY DEFINER RPC for the same RLS
  /// reason as [linkChildToParent].
  Future<void> linkStudentToTeacher(
    String teacherId,
    String studentEmail,
  ) async {
    try {
      await _client.rpc(
        'link_student_by_email',
        params: {'student_email': studentEmail.trim()},
      );
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('linkStudentToTeacher error: ${e.message}');
      throw Exception(e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('linkStudentToTeacher error: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Fetch children linked to a parent
  Future<List<UserProfile>> fetchChildren(String parentId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('profiles')
          .select()
          .eq('parent_id', parentId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      return (response as List)
          .map((json) => UserProfile.fromJson(json))
          .toList();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('fetchChildren error: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  /// Fetch students linked to a teacher
  Future<List<UserProfile>> fetchStudents(String teacherId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('profiles')
          .select()
          .eq('teacher_id', teacherId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      return (response as List)
          .map((json) => UserProfile.fromJson(json))
          .toList();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('fetchStudents error: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  /// Fetch student statistics
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> fetchStudentStats(String studentId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('student_stats')
          .select()
          .eq('student_id', studentId)
          .maybeSingle();
      return response;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('fetchStudentStats error: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Sync student statistics to Supabase
  Future<void> syncStudentStats(
    String studentId, {
    required int learningPoints,
    required int gamesPlayed,
    required int dayStreak,
  }) async {
    try {
      if (kIsWeb) {
        await WebStatsSync(_client).save(
          studentId,
          learningPoints: learningPoints,
          gamesPlayed: gamesPlayed,
          dayStreak: dayStreak,
        );
        return;
      }
      await _client.from('student_stats').upsert({
        'student_id': studentId,
        'learning_points': learningPoints,
        'games_played': gamesPlayed,
        'day_streak': dayStreak,
        'last_played_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('syncStudentStats error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Push a completed game session to Supabase for dashboard analytics.
  ///
  /// Best-effort: swallows errors like [syncStudentStats] so gameplay is never
  /// blocked by a failed sync.
  Future<void> syncGameSession(
    String studentId,
    GameSessionData session,
  ) async {
    try {
      await _client.from('game_sessions').insert({
        'student_id': studentId,
        'game_type': session.gameType,
        'difficulty': session.difficulty,
        'correct_actions': session.correctActions,
        'total_actions': session.totalActions,
        'accuracy_percent': session.accuracyPercent,
        'stars_earned': session.starsEarned,
        'duration_seconds': session.durationSeconds,
        'session_ended_at': session.sessionEndedAt.toIso8601String(),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('syncGameSession error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Fetch a student's recorded game sessions (newest first) for dashboards.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchStudentSessions(
    String studentId, {
    int limit = 200,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('game_sessions')

  /// Assign homework to a student
  Future<void> assignHomework(

          .from('assignments')
          .select()
          .eq('student_id', studentId)

  /// Fetch rewards assigned to one child, oldest first.
  Future<List<ChildRewardData>> fetchChildRewards(String childId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('child_rewards')
          .select()

          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

  /// Create a reward for a linked child.
  Future<ChildRewardData> createChildReward({
    required String childId,
    required String prize,
    required String conditionType,
    required int targetCount,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('child_rewards')
          .insert({
            'child_id': childId,
            'prize': prize.trim(),
            'condition_type': conditionType,

          })
          .select()
          .single();
      return ChildRewardData.fromJson(response);
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('createChildReward error: ${e.message}');

      debugPrint('createChildReward error: $e');
      throw Exception('The reward could not be saved. Please try again.');

  }

  /// Persist progress made by the child toward a parent-created reward.
  Future<void> updateChildRewardProgress({
    required String rewardId,
    required int currentProgress,
    required bool isCompleted,
  }) async {
    try {
      await _client
          .from('child_rewards')
          .update({
            'current_progress': currentProgress,
            'is_completed': isCompleted,
            'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          })
          .eq('id', rewardId);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('updateChildRewardProgress error: $e');

  }

  /// Mark a completed reward as claimed by the child.
  Future<void> claimChildReward(String rewardId) async {
    try {
      await _client
          .from('child_rewards')
          .update({
            'is_claimed': true,
            'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          })
          .eq('id', rewardId);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('claimChildReward error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Remove a reward from a linked child's list.
  Future<void> deleteChildReward(String rewardId) async {
    try {
      await _client.from('child_rewards').delete().eq('id', rewardId);
    } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('deleteChildReward error: ${e.message}');
      throw Exception('The reward could not be removed. Please try again.');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('deleteChildReward error: $e');
      throw Exception('The reward could not be removed. Please try again.');
    }
  }

  /// Update assignment progress
  Future<void> updateAssignmentProgress(
    String assignmentId,
    int progress,
    bool isCompleted,
  ) async {
    try {
      await _client
          .from('assignments')
          .update({'current_count': progress, 'is_completed': isCompleted})
          .eq('id', assignmentId);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('updateAssignmentProgress error: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Add custom classmate name/noun to class word bank
  Future<void> addClassWord(
    String teacherId,
    String word, {
    String? category,
    String? imageUrl,
  }) async {
    try {
      await _client.from('class_words').insert({
        'teacher_id': teacherId,
        'word': word.trim(),
        'category': category ?? 'noun',
        'image_url': imageUrl,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('addClassWord error: $e');
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Fetch custom words for a classroom (from teacher ID)
  Future<List<ClassWord>> fetchClassWords(String teacherId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('class_words')
          .select('*')
          .eq('teacher_id', teacherId);
      return (response as List)
          .map((json) => ClassWord.fromJson(json as Map<String, dynamic>))
          .toList();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('fetchClassWords error: $e');
      return [];
    }
  }

  /// Convert Supabase error messages to user-friendly messages
  String _getFriendlyErrorMessage(String error) {
    final lower = error.toLowerCase();

    if (lower.contains('invalid credentials')) {
      return 'Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('email not confirmed')) {
      return 'Please check your email to confirm your account.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('user not found')) {
      return 'No account found with this email.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('email already registered')) {
      return 'An account with this email already exists.';
    }
    if (lower.contains('password')) {
      return 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.';
    }

    return 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
  }
}

class ClassWord {
  final String id;
  final String word;
  final String? category;
  final String? imageUrl;

  const ClassWord({
    required this.id,
    required this.word,
    this.category,
    this.imageUrl,
  });

  factory ClassWord.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return ClassWord(
      id: json['id'] as String? ?? '',
      word: json['word'] as String? ?? '',
      category: json['category'] as String?,
      imageUrl: json['image_url'] as String?,
    );
  }
}
```

## lib/src/state/caretaker_controller.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../data/repositories/caretaker_repository.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';

class CaretakerController extends ChangeNotifier {
  CaretakerController(this.accountId, this.repository);
  final String accountId;
  final CaretakerRepository repository;
  CaretakerRoster? roster;
  String? selectedId;
  String? error;
  bool loading = false;
  bool _disposed = false;
  int _request = 0;
  List<UserProfile> get children =>
      roster?.children.where((c) => c.inCare).map((c) => c.profile).toList() ??
      [];
  UserProfile? get selected {
    for (final child in children) {
      if (child.id == selectedId) return child;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final request = ++_request;
    loading = true;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final data = await repository.load();
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (_disposed || request != _request) return;
      roster = data;
      final previous =
          selectedId ?? prefs.getString('caretaker.selected_child.$accountId');
      selectedId = children.any((c) => c.id == previous)
          ? previous
          : children.firstOrNull?.id;
    } catch (e) {
      if (!_disposed && request == _request) error = caretakerError(e);
    } finally {
      if (!_disposed && request == _request) {
        loading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> select(String id) async {
    if (!children.any((c) => c.id == id)) return;
    selectedId = id;
    notifyListeners();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (!_disposed) {
      await prefs.setString('caretaker.selected_child.$accountId', id);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _request++;
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```
