```sql
-- Additive: legacy role values, analytical policies and game tables are untouched.
create schema if not exists caretaker_private;
revoke all on schema caretaker_private from public, anon;
grant usage on schema caretaker_private to authenticated;

create table public.caretaker_children (
  caretaker_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  child_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  legacy_parent boolean not null default false,
  legacy_teacher boolean not null default false,
  direct_link boolean not null default false,
  is_in_care boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(caretaker_id,child_id),
  check(caretaker_id<>child_id),
  check(legacy_parent or legacy_teacher or direct_link)
);
create index caretaker_children_child_idx on public.caretaker_children(child_id);
create table public.caretaker_preferences (
  caretaker_id uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  planned_child_count integer not null default 1 check(planned_child_count>=0),
  revision integer not null default 1 check(revision>0),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table public.child_game_configs (
  child_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  game_key text not null check(game_key in ('social_chat','flashcard','minipuzzle','emotion','fruit_catching_bear')),
  schema_version integer not null default 1 check(schema_version=1),
  payload jsonb not null,
  revision integer not null default 1 check(revision>0),
  updated_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key(child_id,game_key)
);
create index child_game_configs_updated_by_idx on public.child_game_configs(updated_by);
alter table public.caretaker_children enable row level security;
alter table public.caretaker_preferences enable row level security;
alter table public.child_game_configs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.caretaker_children,public.caretaker_preferences,public.child_game_configs from anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.caretaker_children,public.caretaker_preferences,public.child_game_configs to authenticated;

create function caretaker_private.assert_adult() returns uuid
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
  if actor is null or not exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=actor and role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker')) then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Caretaker access required';
  end if;
  return actor;
end $$;
create policy caretaker_own_links on public.caretaker_children for select to authenticated
using(caretaker_id=(select auth.uid()));
create policy caretaker_own_preferences on public.caretaker_preferences for select to authenticated
using(caretaker_id=(select auth.uid()));
create function caretaker_private.can_read_config(target uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
  select exists(select 1 from public.caretaker_children c join public.profiles p on p.id=c.caretaker_id
    where c.caretaker_id=(select auth.uid()) and c.child_id=target and p.role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker'));
$$;
create policy caretaker_linked_config on public.child_game_configs for select to authenticated
using(caretaker_private.can_read_config(child_id));

-- Retain both sources if one account appears in both old relationship fields.
insert into public.caretaker_children(caretaker_id,child_id,legacy_parent,legacy_teacher,is_in_care)
select adult.id,child.id,coalesce(bool_or(child.parent_id=adult.id),false),coalesce(bool_or(child.teacher_id=adult.id),false),true
from public.profiles child join public.profiles adult on adult.id in (child.parent_id,child.teacher_id)
where child.role='child' and adult.role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker') and child.id<>adult.id
group by adult.id,child.id;
insert into public.caretaker_preferences(caretaker_id,planned_child_count)
select p.id,count(c.child_id)::integer from public.profiles p left join public.caretaker_children c on c.caretaker_id=p.id
where p.role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker') group by p.id;

create function caretaker_private.roster() returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=caretaker_private.assert_adult(); result jsonb;
begin
  insert into public.caretaker_preferences(caretaker_id) values(actor) on conflict do nothing;
  select jsonb_build_object('planned_count',p.planned_child_count,'revision',p.revision,'children',
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',ch.id,'name',ch.name,'age',ch.age,'created_at',ch.created_at,'is_in_care',c.is_in_care)
      order by ch.created_at,ch.id) from public.caretaker_children c join public.profiles ch on ch.id=c.child_id
      where c.caretaker_id=actor and ch.role='child'),'[]'::jsonb)) into result
  from public.caretaker_preferences p where p.caretaker_id=actor;
  return result;
end $$;
create function public.caretaker_roster() returns jsonb language sql security invoker set search_path='' as $$select caretaker_private.roster()$$;

create function caretaker_private.link_child(child_email text) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=caretaker_private.assert_adult(); target uuid; affected integer;
begin
  select id into target from public.profiles where role='child' and lower(email)=lower(trim(child_email));
  if target is null then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Child account unavailable'; end if;
  insert into public.caretaker_preferences(caretaker_id) values(actor) on conflict do nothing;
  perform 1 from public.caretaker_preferences where caretaker_id=actor for update;
  insert into public.caretaker_children(caretaker_id,child_id,direct_link) values(actor,target,true)
  on conflict(caretaker_id,child_id) do update set direct_link=true where not caretaker_children.direct_link;
  get diagnostics affected=row_count;
  if affected>0 then update public.caretaker_preferences set revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() where caretaker_id=actor; end if;
end $$;
create function public.caretaker_link_child(child_email text) returns void language sql security invoker set search_path='' as $$select caretaker_private.link_child(child_email)$$;

create function caretaker_private.save_roster(planned_count integer,child_ids uuid[],expected_revision integer) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=caretaker_private.assert_adult(); current_revision integer;
begin
  select revision into current_revision from public.caretaker_preferences where caretaker_id=actor for update;
  if current_revision is distinct from expected_revision then raise exception using errcode='40001',message='Roster revision conflict';end if;
  if planned_count is null or planned_count<0 or child_ids is null or cardinality(child_ids)>planned_count
    or cardinality(child_ids)<>(select count(distinct x) from unnest(child_ids) x)
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(child_ids) id where not exists(select 1 from public.caretaker_children c join public.profiles p on p.id=c.child_id where c.caretaker_id=actor and c.child_id=id and p.role='child')) then
    raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Invalid care list';
  end if;
  update public.caretaker_children set is_in_care=(child_id=any(child_ids)) where caretaker_id=actor;
  update public.caretaker_preferences set planned_child_count=planned_count,revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() where caretaker_id=actor;
end $$;
create function public.caretaker_save_roster(planned_count integer,child_ids uuid[],expected_revision integer) returns void language sql security invoker set search_path='' as $$select caretaker_private.save_roster(planned_count,child_ids,expected_revision)$$;

create function caretaker_private.valid_subset(value jsonb,allowed jsonb,minimum integer) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
select jsonb_typeof(value)='array' and jsonb_array_length(value)>=minimum and value<@allowed
and jsonb_array_length(value)=(select count(distinct x) from jsonb_array_elements(value) x);
$$;
create function caretaker_private.valid_config(game text,p jsonb) returns boolean
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare card jsonb; image text; item jsonb; field text; allowed text[];
begin
  if p is null or jsonb_typeof(p)<>'object' or octet_length(p::text)>2097152 then return false;end if;
  case game
  when 'social_chat' then
    if not (p->>'input_mode'=any(array['text_and_voice','text_only']) and p->>'reply_speech'=any(array['automatic','on_tap']) and p->'listen_seconds'<@'[15,30,45]'::jsonb and p->'pause_seconds'<@'[3,5,8]'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof(p->'starter_phrases')='array' and jsonb_array_length(p->'starter_phrases')<=6) then return false;end if;
    for item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p->'starter_phrases') loop if jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' or length(trim(item#>>'{}')) not between 1 and 80 or (item#>>'{}')<>trim(item#>>'{}') then return false;end if;end loop;
    if (select count(*)<>count(distinct x) from jsonb_array_elements(p->'starter_phrases') x) then return false;end if;
    allowed:=array['input_mode','reply_speech','listen_seconds','pause_seconds','starter_phrases'];
  when 'flashcard' then
    if not(p->>'difficulty'=any(array['child_choice','easy','medium','hard']) and p->>'language'=any(array['app','en','th']) and p->>'preview_pace'=any(array['2_seconds','3_seconds','5_seconds','manual']) and jsonb_typeof(p->'auto_speak')='boolean' and jsonb_typeof(p->'use_custom_cards')='boolean' and jsonb_typeof(p->'custom_cards')='array' and jsonb_array_length(p->'custom_cards')<=20) then return false;end if;
    if p->'use_custom_cards'='true'::jsonb and jsonb_array_length(p->'custom_cards')=0 then return false;end if;
    for card in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p->'custom_cards') loop
      if jsonb_typeof(card)<>'object' or jsonb_typeof(card->'id')<>'string' or length(card->>'id') not between 1 and 64 or jsonb_typeof(card->'word')<>'string' or length(trim(card->>'word')) not between 1 and 40 or not(card->>'category'=any(array['noun','pronoun','verb','adjective','adverb'])) then return false;end if;
      image:=card->>'image_url';
      if image is not null and image<>'' then
        if image like 'data:image/jpeg;base64,%' or image like 'data:image/png;base64,%' then
          if octet_length(decode(split_part(image,',',2),'base64'))>131072 then return false;end if;
        elsif image!~'^assets/images/games/flashcard/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]+\.png$' then return false;
        end if;
      end if;
    end loop;
    if (select count(*)<>count(distinct x->>'id') or count(*)<>count(distinct ((x->>'category')||':'||lower(trim(x->>'word')))) from jsonb_array_elements(p->'custom_cards') x) then return false;end if;
    allowed:=array['difficulty','language','preview_pace','auto_speak','use_custom_cards','custom_cards'];
  when 'minipuzzle' then
    if not caretaker_private.valid_subset(p->'enabled_types','["pattern","oddOneOut","puzzle"]',1) then return false;end if;
    foreach field in array array['pattern_difficulty','odd_one_out_difficulty','puzzle_difficulty'] loop if not(p->>field=any(array['child_choice','easy','medium','hard'])) then return false;end if;end loop;
    if not(p->>'advance_mode'=any(array['automatic_900ms','automatic_1800ms','manual']) and jsonb_typeof(p->'show_guide')='boolean') then return false;end if;
    allowed:=array['enabled_types','pattern_difficulty','odd_one_out_difficulty','puzzle_difficulty','advance_mode','show_guide'];
  when 'emotion' then
    if not(caretaker_private.valid_subset(p->'target_emotions','["happy","sad","angry","scared"]',2) and p->'choice_count'<@'[2,4]'::jsonb and p->'round_count'<@'[1,3,5]'::jsonb and (p->>'choice_count')::integer<=jsonb_array_length(p->'target_emotions') and p->>'image_mode'=any(array['varied','consistent']) and p->>'advance_mode'=any(array['automatic_1500ms','automatic_3000ms','manual']) and jsonb_typeof(p->'show_guide')='boolean') then return false;end if;
    allowed:=array['target_emotions','choice_count','round_count','image_mode','advance_mode','show_guide'];
  when 'fruit_catching_bear' then
    if not(p->>'fall_speed'=any(array['slow','standard','fast']) and p->'spawn_interval_ms'<@'[900,1200,1500]'::jsonb and p->'bomb_probability'<@'[0,0.1,0.2]'::jsonb and p->'bomb_grace_count'<@'[2,5,10]'::jsonb and p->'duration_seconds'<@'[null,30,60,120]'::jsonb and caretaker_private.valid_subset(p->'fruit_ids','["4","5","6","7","8","9"]',1) and jsonb_typeof(p->'show_guide')='boolean') then return false;end if;
    if p->'bomb_probability'='0'::jsonb and p->'duration_seconds'='null'::jsonb then return false;end if;
    allowed:=array['fall_speed','spawn_interval_ms','bomb_probability','bomb_grace_count','duration_seconds','fruit_ids','show_guide'];
  else return false;
  end case;
  -- Required fields must exist; SQL NULL must never bypass a validation branch.
  if not(p ?& allowed) or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p) k where not(k=any(allowed))) then return false;end if;
  foreach field in array allowed loop
    if p->field='null'::jsonb and field<>'duration_seconds' then return false;end if;
    if field=any(array['listen_seconds','pause_seconds','choice_count','round_count','spawn_interval_ms','bomb_grace_count']) and (jsonb_typeof(p->field)<>'number' or (p->>field)!~'^[0-9]+$') then return false;end if;
    if field='bomb_probability' and jsonb_typeof(p->field)<>'number' then return false;end if;
    if field='duration_seconds' and (jsonb_typeof(p->field) not in ('null','number') or (jsonb_typeof(p->field)='number' and (p->>field)!~'^[0-9]+$')) then return false;end if;
  end loop;
  return true;
exception when others then return false;
end $$;

alter table public.child_game_configs add constraint child_game_config_valid check(caretaker_private.valid_config(game_key,payload));
create function caretaker_private.save_config(target_child uuid,target_game text,config_payload jsonb,expected_revision integer) returns integer
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=caretaker_private.assert_adult(); current_revision integer; next_revision integer;
begin
  -- Serializes saves, first inserts and revocation of this Caretaker's care selection.
  perform 1 from public.caretaker_preferences where caretaker_id=actor for update;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.caretaker_children c join public.profiles p on p.id=c.child_id where c.caretaker_id=actor and c.child_id=target_child and c.is_in_care and p.role='child') then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Child is not in your care list';end if;
  if not caretaker_private.valid_config(target_game,config_payload) then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Invalid game configuration';end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(target_child::text||target_game,0));
  select revision into current_revision from public.child_game_configs where child_id=target_child and game_key=target_game for update;
  if coalesce(current_revision,0) is distinct from expected_revision then raise exception using errcode='40001',message='Configuration revision conflict';end if;
  next_revision:=coalesce(current_revision,0)+1;
  insert into public.child_game_configs(child_id,game_key,payload,revision,updated_by) values(target_child,target_game,config_payload,next_revision,actor)
  on conflict(child_id,game_key) do update set payload=excluded.payload,revision=excluded.revision,updated_by=actor,updated_at=now();
  return next_revision;
end $$;
create function public.caretaker_save_config(target_child uuid,target_game text,config_payload jsonb,expected_revision integer) returns integer language sql security invoker set search_path='' as $$select caretaker_private.save_config(target_child,target_game,config_payload,expected_revision)$$;

create function caretaker_private.sync_legacy_links() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid;
begin
  -- Lock affected adult preferences in stable order before changing associations.
  for actor in select distinct id from unnest(array[old.parent_id,old.teacher_id,new.parent_id,new.teacher_id]) id where id is not null order by id loop
    insert into public.caretaker_preferences(caretaker_id,planned_child_count) select actor,0 from public.profiles where id=actor and role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker') on conflict do nothing;
    perform 1 from public.caretaker_preferences where caretaker_id=actor for update;
    delete from public.caretaker_children where caretaker_id=actor and child_id=new.id and not direct_link and (new.role<>'child' or (new.parent_id is distinct from actor and new.teacher_id is distinct from actor));
    update public.caretaker_children set legacy_parent=(new.role='child' and new.parent_id is not distinct from actor),legacy_teacher=(new.role='child' and new.teacher_id is not distinct from actor) where caretaker_id=actor and child_id=new.id;
    if new.role='child' and actor in (new.parent_id,new.teacher_id) then
      insert into public.caretaker_children(caretaker_id,child_id,legacy_parent,legacy_teacher)
      select actor,new.id,new.parent_id is not distinct from actor,new.teacher_id is not distinct from actor from public.profiles where id=actor and role in ('parent','teacher','caretaker') and actor<>new.id
      on conflict(caretaker_id,child_id) do update set legacy_parent=excluded.legacy_parent,legacy_teacher=excluded.legacy_teacher;
    end if;
    update public.caretaker_preferences set revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() where caretaker_id=actor;
  end loop;
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger caretaker_sync_legacy after insert or update of parent_id,teacher_id,role on public.profiles for each row execute function caretaker_private.sync_legacy_links();

-- New authorization uses the stored role, so direct client role changes are forbidden.
create function caretaker_private.protect_role() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path='' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and new.role is distinct from old.role then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Role changes require an administrator';end if;
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger caretaker_protect_role before update of role on public.profiles for each row execute function caretaker_private.protect_role();

revoke all on all functions in schema caretaker_private from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function caretaker_private.roster(),caretaker_private.link_child(text),caretaker_private.save_roster(integer,uuid[],integer),caretaker_private.save_config(uuid,text,jsonb,integer),caretaker_private.can_read_config(uuid) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.caretaker_roster(),public.caretaker_link_child(text),public.caretaker_save_roster(integer,uuid[],integer),public.caretaker_save_config(uuid,text,jsonb,integer) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.caretaker_roster(),public.caretaker_link_child(text),public.caretaker_save_roster(integer,uuid[],integer),public.caretaker_save_config(uuid,text,jsonb,integer) to authenticated;
notify pgrst,'reload schema';
```

```dart
class MemoryConfigurations extends GameConfigurationRepository {
  MemoryConfigurations() : super(Supabase.instance.client);
  final Map<String, SavedGameConfiguration> records = {};
  bool conflict = false;
  @override
  Future<SavedGameConfiguration> load(
    String childId,
    CaretakerGame game,
  ) async =>
      records['$childId:${game.key}'] ??
      SavedGameConfiguration(GameConfiguration.defaults(game), 0);
  @override
  Future<SavedGameConfiguration> save(
    String childId,
    GameConfiguration config,
    int revision,
  ) async {
    if (conflict) {
      throw const PostgrestException(
        message: 'revision conflict',
        code: '40001',
      );
    }
    final result = SavedGameConfiguration(config, revision + 1);
    records['$childId:${config.game.key}'] = result;
    return result;
  }
}

class MemoryRoster extends CaretakerRepository {
  MemoryRoster(this.roster) : super(Supabase.instance.client);
  CaretakerRoster roster;
  int saves = 0;
  final List<String> progressReads = [];
  @override
  Future<ChildProgressSnapshot> progress(String childId) async {
    progressReads.add(childId);
    return ChildProgressSnapshot(
      stats: {
        'learning_points': childId == 'Ari' ? 275 : 150,
        'games_played': 42,
        'day_streak': 3,
        'last_played_at': '2026-10-24T09:00:00Z',
      },
      sessions: [
        {
          'game_type': 'emotion_classify',
          'difficulty': 'easy',
          'session_ended_at': '2026-10-24T09:00:00Z',
          'accuracy_percent': 80,
          'duration_seconds': 15,
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<CaretakerRoster> load() async => roster;
  @override
  Future<void> save(int count, Set<String> ids, int revision) async {
    saves++;
    roster = CaretakerRoster(
      [
        for (final child in roster.children)
          CaretakerChild(child.profile, ids.contains(child.profile.id)),
      ],
      count,
      revision + 1,
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:audy_app/src/state/audy_controller.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  setUpAll(() async {
    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
    final messenger =
        TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger;
    for (final channel in [
      'xyz.luan/audioplayers',
      'xyz.luan/audioplayers.global',
      'flutter_tts',
    ]) {
      messenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(
        MethodChannel(channel),
        (_) async => 1,
      );
    }
    messenger.setMockStreamHandler(
      const EventChannel('xyz.luan/audioplayers.global/events'),
      MockStreamHandler.inline(onListen: (_, sink) {}),
    );
    TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger
        .setMockMethodCallHandler(
          const MethodChannel('plugin.csdcorp.com/speech_to_text'),
          (_) async => true,
        );
    await Supabase.initialize(
      url: 'https://example.supabase.co',
      anonKey: 'test-anon-key',
    );
  });

  tearDownAll(() {
    TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger
        .setMockMethodCallHandler(
          const MethodChannel('plugin.csdcorp.com/speech_to_text'),
          null,
        );
  });

  test('completing an emotion round advances both games together', () {
    final controller = AudyController();
    addTearDown(controller.dispose);

    controller.completeEmotionRound(isMatch: true, confidence: 0.9);

    expect(controller.mimicCurrentRound, 2);
    expect(controller.classifyCurrentRound, 2);
    expect(controller.mimicScore, 1);
  });

  test('incorrect mimic still advances the combined emotion round', () {
    final controller = AudyController();
    addTearDown(controller.dispose);

    controller.completeEmotionRound(isMatch: false, confidence: 0.4);

    expect(controller.mimicCurrentRound, 2);
    expect(controller.classifyCurrentRound, 2);
    expect(controller.mimicScore, 0);
  });

  test('combined rounds stay synchronized until completion', () {
    final controller = AudyController();
    addTearDown(controller.dispose);

    for (var completedRound = 1; completedRound <= 3; completedRound += 1) {
      controller.completeEmotionRound(isMatch: true, confidence: 0.9);

      expect(controller.mimicCurrentRound, completedRound + 1);
      expect(controller.classifyCurrentRound, completedRound + 1);
    }

    expect(controller.isMimicGameComplete, isTrue);
    expect(controller.isClassifyGameComplete, isTrue);

    controller.completeEmotionRound(isMatch: true, confidence: 0.9);
    expect(controller.mimicCurrentRound, 4);
    expect(controller.classifyCurrentRound, 4);
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:audy_app/src/data/models/game_configuration.dart';
import 'package:audy_app/src/services/auth_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

void main() {
  for (final game in CaretakerGame.values) {
    test('${game.key} defaults validate and survive JSON roundtrip', () {
      final config = GameConfiguration.defaults(game);
      expect(config.validate(), isEmpty);
      expect(
        GameConfiguration(
          game,
          jsonDecode(jsonEncode(config.toJson())) as Map<String, dynamic>,
        ).toJson(),
        config.toJson(),
      );
    });
  }
  test('draft changes cannot mutate a snapshot used by preview', () {
    final draft = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.emotion).toJson();
    final config = GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.emotion, draft);
    (draft['target_emotions'] as List).clear();
    (config.toJson()['target_emotions'] as List).clear();
    expect(config.validate(), isEmpty);
  });
  test('reject four emotion choices with two selected emotions', () {
    final v = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.emotion).toJson()
      ..['target_emotions'] = ['happy', 'sad'];
    expect(GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.emotion, v).validate(), isNotEmpty);
  });
  test('bomb-free fruit game requires a finite duration', () {
    final v = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.fruitCatch).toJson()
      ..['bomb_probability'] = 0;
    expect(
      GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.fruitCatch, v).validate(),
      isNotEmpty,
    );
    v['duration_seconds'] = 30;
    expect(GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.fruitCatch, v).validate(), isEmpty);
  });
  test('legacy FlashCard word types survive the customization merge', () {
    final v = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.flashcard).toJson()
      ..['custom_cards'] = [
        for (final type in ['noun', 'pronoun', 'verb', 'adjective', 'adverb'])
          {'id': type, 'word': type, 'category': type, 'image_url': null},
      ]
      ..['use_custom_cards'] = true;
    expect(GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.flashcard, v).validate(), isEmpty);
  });
  test('reject duplicate and oversized custom cards', () {
    final card = {
      'id': 'a',
      'word': 'apple',
      'category': 'noun',
      'image_url': null,
    };
    final v = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.flashcard).toJson()
      ..['custom_cards'] = [card, card];
    expect(
      GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.flashcard, v).validate(),
      isNotEmpty,
    );
    v['custom_cards'] = [
      {
        ...card,
        'image_url':
            'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(List.filled(131073, 0))}',
      },
    ];
    expect(
      GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.flashcard, v).validate(),
      isNotEmpty,
    );
  });
  test(
    'reject duplicate conversation starters and empty activity selection',
    () {
      final social = GameConfiguration.defaults(
        CaretakerGame.socialChat,
      ).toJson()..['starter_phrases'] = ['hello', 'hello'];
      expect(
        GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.socialChat, social).validate(),
        isNotEmpty,
      );
      final mini = GameConfiguration.defaults(CaretakerGame.miniPuzzle).toJson()
        ..['enabled_types'] = [];
      expect(
        GameConfiguration(CaretakerGame.miniPuzzle, mini).validate(),
        isNotEmpty,
      );
    },
  );
  test('adult role aliases normalize without rewriting stored role', () {
    for (final role in ['parent', 'teacher', 'caretaker']) {
      final profile = UserProfile(
        id: 'a',
        name: 'A',
        age: 0,
        createdAt: DateTime(2026),
        role: role,
      );
      expect(profile.mode, AppMode.caretaker);
      expect(profile.role, role);
    }
    expect(
      UserProfile(
        id: 'a',
        name: 'A',
        age: 0,
        createdAt: DateTime(2026),
        role: 'unknown',
      ).mode,
      AppMode.unknown,
    );
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'audy_theme.dart';
import '../state/audy_controller.dart';

/// Shared controls using the original Parent palette and generous touch targets.
class AudyControls extends StatelessWidget {
  const AudyControls({super.key, required this.child});
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Theme(
      data: theme.copyWith(
        filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(48, 56),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFBDD8F2),
            foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
            shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          ),
        ),
        elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(48, 56),
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFBDD8F2),
            foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
            shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          ),
        ),
        outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(48, 56),
            foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
            shape: const StadiumBorder(),
          ),
        ),
        textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
            foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
          ),
        ),
        iconButtonTheme: IconButtonThemeData(
          style: IconButton.styleFrom(minimumSize: const Size(48, 48)),
        ),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

class AudyAdaptive {
  const AudyAdaptive({required this.width, required this.height});

  final double width;
  final double height;

  bool get isPhone => width < 600;
  bool get isTablet => width >= 600 && width < 1024;
  bool get isDesktop => width >= 1024;

  double get scale => (width / 390).clamp(0.92, 1.35);
  double space(double value) => value * scale;
  double get contentMaxWidth => isPhone ? width : (isTablet ? 860 : 1180);

  int columns({required int phone, required int tablet, required int desktop}) {
    if (isDesktop) return desktop;
    if (isTablet) return tablet;
    return phone;
  }
}

class AudyResponsivePage extends StatelessWidget {
  const AudyResponsivePage({
    super.key,
    required this.builder,
    this.scrollable = true,
  });

  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, AudyAdaptive adaptive) builder;
  final bool scrollable;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final width = constraints.maxWidth.isFinite
            ? constraints.maxWidth
            : MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
        final height = constraints.maxHeight.isFinite
            ? constraints.maxHeight
            : MediaQuery.of(context).size.height;
        final adaptive = AudyAdaptive(width: width, height: height);

        final padding = EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: adaptive.isPhone
              ? AudySpacing.screenPadding
              : adaptive.space(28),
          vertical: adaptive.isPhone
              ? AudySpacing.screenPadding
              : adaptive.space(28),
        );

        final content = Padding(
          padding: padding,
          child: builder(context, adaptive),
        );

        return Scaffold(
          body: DecoratedBox(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              image:
                  AudyScope.maybeOf(context)?.appSettings.plainBackground ==
                      true
                  ? null
                  : const DecorationImage(
                      image: AssetImage('assets/images/background.png'),
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                      opacity: 0.5, // Semi-transparent (50% visibility)
                    ),
              color: AudyColors.backgroundPrimary,
            ),
            child: SafeArea(
              child: Center(
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: BoxConstraints(
                    maxWidth: adaptive.contentMaxWidth,
                  ),
                  child: scrollable
                      ? SingleChildScrollView(child: content)
                      : content,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Large, icon-first activity card designed for visual recognition
class AudyBigIconCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const AudyBigIconCard({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.icon,
    required this.iconColor,
    required this.borderColor,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String title;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color iconColor;
  final Color borderColor;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  State<AudyBigIconCard> createState() => _AudyBigIconCardState();
}

class _AudyBigIconCardState extends State<AudyBigIconCard>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: AudyAnimation.quick,
      vsync: this,
      lowerBound: 0.97,
      upperBound: 1.0,
    );
    _scaleAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
    _controller.value = 1.0;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onTapDown(TapDownDetails details) {
    _controller.reverse();
  }

  void _onTapUp(TapUpDetails details) {
    _controller.forward();
  }

  void _onTapCancel() {
    _controller.forward();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        // Title ABOVE the container
        Text(
          widget.title,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: AudyTypography.cardTitle,
          maxLines: 2,
          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: AudySpacing.smallGap),
        // Card container with maximized icon
        GestureDetector(
          onTapDown: _onTapDown,
          onTapUp: _onTapUp,
          onTapCancel: _onTapCancel,
          onTap: widget.onTap,
          child: ScaleTransition(
            scale: _scaleAnimation,
            child: Container(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 160),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AudySpacing.cardPadding),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: AudyColors.backgroundCard,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AudySpacing.radiusLarge),
                border: Border.all(color: widget.borderColor, width: 3),
                boxShadow: AudyShadows.cardShadow,
              ),
              child: Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 112,
                  height: 112,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: widget.iconColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(widget.icon, size: 96, color: widget.iconColor),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Responsive grid for activity cards
class AudyAdaptiveGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const AudyAdaptiveGrid({
    super.key,
    required this.adaptive,
    required this.phoneColumns,
    required this.tabletColumns,
    required this.desktopColumns,
    required this.items,
  });

  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;
  final int phoneColumns;
  final int tabletColumns;
  final int desktopColumns;
  final List<Widget> items;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final columns = adaptive.columns(
      phone: phoneColumns,
      tablet: tabletColumns,
      desktop: desktopColumns,
    );

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final spacing = adaptive.space(20);
        final itemWidth =
            (constraints.maxWidth - (spacing * (columns - 1))) / columns;

        return Wrap(
          spacing: spacing,
          runSpacing: spacing,
          children: items
              .map((item) => SizedBox(width: itemWidth, child: item))
              .toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

/// Device preferences, independent of accounts and child learning preferences.
class AppSettings {
  const AppSettings({
    this.language = 'en',
    this.largerText = false,
    this.soundEffects = true,
    this.plainBackground = false,
  });

  final String language;
  final bool largerText;
  final bool soundEffects;
  final bool plainBackground;

  AppSettings copyWith({
    String? language,
    bool? largerText,
    bool? soundEffects,
    bool? plainBackground,
  }) => AppSettings(
    language: language ?? this.language,
    largerText: largerText ?? this.largerText,
    soundEffects: soundEffects ?? this.soundEffects,
    plainBackground: plainBackground ?? this.plainBackground,
  );

  static Future<AppSettings> load() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return AppSettings(
      language: prefs.getString('app.language') == 'th' ? 'th' : 'en',
      largerText: prefs.getBool('app.largerText') ?? false,
      soundEffects: prefs.getBool('app.soundEffects') ?? true,
      plainBackground: prefs.getBool('app.plainBackground') ?? false,
    );
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final saved = await Future.wait([
      prefs.setString('app.language', language),
      prefs.setBool('app.largerText', largerText),
      prefs.setBool('app.soundEffects', soundEffects),
      prefs.setBool('app.plainBackground', plainBackground),
    ]);
    if (saved.any((success) => !success)) {
      throw StateError('Settings not saved');
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
class ChildProgressSnapshot {
  const ChildProgressSnapshot({
    this.stats,
    this.sessions = const [],
    this.assignments = const [],
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic>? stats;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> sessions;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> assignments;

  factory ChildProgressSnapshot.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      ChildProgressSnapshot(
        stats: json['stats'] == null
            ? null
            : Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['stats'] as Map),
        sessions: (json['sessions'] as List)
            .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
            .toList(),
        assignments: (json['assignments'] as List)
            .map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(row as Map))
            .toList(),
      );
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/audy_ui.dart';
import '../../state/audy_controller.dart';
import '../../state/app_settings.dart';
import '../caretaker/caretaker_ui.dart';

class AppSettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppSettingsPage({super.key, this.legacyTools});
  final Widget? legacyTools;

  @override
  State<AppSettingsPage> createState() => _AppSettingsPageState();
}

class _AppSettingsPageState extends State<AppSettingsPage> {
  bool _saving = false;
  String? _error;

  Future<void> _save(AppSettings value) async {
    setState(() {
      _saving = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await AudyScope.of(context).saveAppSettings(value);
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              ct(
                context,
                'Settings saved on this device.',
                'บันทึกการตั้งค่าในอุปกรณ์นี้แล้ว',
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => _error = ct(
            context,
            'Could not save settings. Please try again.',
            'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาลองอีกครั้ง',
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final settings = AudyScope.of(context).appSettings;
    return AudyControls(
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(ct(context, 'App Settings', 'การตั้งค่าแอป')),
        ),
        body: AudyResponsivePage(
          builder: (context, adaptive) => AudyPanel(
            adaptive: adaptive,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  ct(
                    context,
                    'Applies to this device in both modes.',
                    'ใช้กับทั้งสองโหมดในอุปกรณ์นี้',
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  key: ValueKey(settings.language),
                  initialValue: settings.language,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: ct(context, 'Language', 'ภาษา'),
                  ),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'en', child: Text('English')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'th', child: Text('ไทย')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: _saving
                      ? null
                      : (value) => _save(settings.copyWith(language: value)),
                ),
                SwitchListTile(
                  title: Text(ct(context, 'Larger text', 'ตัวอักษรขนาดใหญ่')),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    ct(
                      context,
                      'Respects your device text size.',
                      'ปรับเพิ่มจากขนาดตัวอักษรของอุปกรณ์',
                    ),
                  ),
                  value: settings.largerText,
                  onChanged: _saving
                      ? null
                      : (value) => _save(settings.copyWith(largerText: value)),
                ),
                SwitchListTile(
                  title: Text(
                    ct(context, 'App sound effects', 'เสียงเอฟเฟกต์แอป'),
                  ),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    ct(
                      context,
                      'Game narration and speech have separate controls.',
                      'เสียงอ่านและเสียงพูดในเกมมีการตั้งค่าแยกกัน',
                    ),
                  ),
                  value: settings.soundEffects,
                  onChanged: _saving
                      ? null
                      : (value) =>
                            _save(settings.copyWith(soundEffects: value)),
                ),
                SwitchListTile(
                  title: Text(ct(context, 'Plain background', 'พื้นหลังเรียบ')),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    ct(
                      context,
                      'Hide the decorative app background.',
                      'ซ่อนภาพพื้นหลังของแอป',
                    ),
                  ),
                  value: settings.plainBackground,
                  onChanged: _saving
                      ? null
                      : (value) =>
                            _save(settings.copyWith(plainBackground: value)),
                ),
                if (_saving) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                if (_error != null) CaretakerNotice(_error!),
                if (widget.legacyTools != null) ...[
                  const Divider(height: 32),
                  widget.legacyTools!,
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ChildProgressDetails extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChildProgressDetails({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.repository,
    required this.adaptive,
    required this.analysis,
  });
  final UserProfile child;
  final CaretakerRepository repository;
  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;
  final bool analysis;
  @override
  State<ChildProgressDetails> createState() => _ChildProgressDetailsState();
}

class _ChildProgressDetailsState extends State<ChildProgressDetails> {
  ChildProgressSnapshot? _data;
  String? _error;
  bool _loading = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final data = await widget.repository.progress(widget.child.id);
      if (mounted) setState(() => _data = data);
    } catch (error) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = caretakerError(error));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_loading) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    if (_error != null) return CaretakerNotice(_error!, onRetry: _load);
    final data = _data!;
    if (widget.analysis) {
      return ParentChildAnalytics(
        key: ValueKey(data),
        child: widget.child,
        adaptive: widget.adaptive,
        snapshot: data,
      );
    }
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        ChildLevelProgress(
          key: ValueKey(data),
          child: widget.child,
          adaptive: widget.adaptive,
          snapshot: data,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        AudyPanel(
          adaptive: widget.adaptive,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Recorded Game History',
                  'ประวัติการเล่นที่บันทึกไว้',
                ),
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Latest 200 recorded sessions. Totals use the existing game counter.',
                  'แสดงการเล่นที่บันทึกล่าสุด 200 ครั้ง ยอดรวมใช้ตัวนับเดิมของแอป',
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                ct(
                  context,
                  'Last active: ${_date(data.stats?['last_played_at'])}',
                  'ใช้งานล่าสุด: ${_date(data.stats?['last_played_at'])}',
                ),
              ),
              const Divider(height: 24),
              if (data.sessions.isEmpty)
                Text(
                  ct(
                    context,
                    'No recorded games yet.',
                    'ยังไม่มีประวัติการเล่น',
                  ),
                ),
              for (final session in data.sessions)
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.sports_esports_outlined),
                  title: Text(
                    '${_gameTitle(session['game_type'])} · ${_difficulty(session['difficulty'])}',
                  ),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    '${_date(session['session_ended_at'])}\n'
                    '${ct(context, 'Accuracy', 'ความแม่นยำ')}: ${session['accuracy_percent']}% · '
                    '${session['duration_seconds']} ${ct(context, 'seconds', 'วินาที')}',
                  ),
                  isThreeLine: true,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  String _date(dynamic raw) {
    final date = raw is String ? DateTime.tryParse(raw)?.toLocal() : null;
    return date == null
        ? ct(context, 'Never', 'ยังไม่มี')
        : '${date.day}/${date.month}/${date.year} ${date.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${date.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  String _gameTitle(dynamic value) {
    const keys = {
      'emotion_classify': 'emotion_classify',
      'emotion_mimic': 'emotion_mimic',
      'minipuzzle': 'mini_puzzle',
      'sorting': 'sorting_game',
      'reaction_time': 'reaction_time',
      'flashcard': 'flashcard_game',
      'fruit_catching_bear': 'fruit_catching_bear',
      'reading': 'read_speak',
      'social_chat': 'social_chat',
    };
    final key = keys[value];
    return key == null
        ? ct(context, 'Game', 'เกม')
        : AudyScope.of(context).tr(key);
  }

  String _difficulty(dynamic value) =>
      ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'].contains(value)
      ? AudyScope.of(context).tr(value as String)
      : ct(context, 'Standard', 'มาตรฐาน');
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/app_routes.dart';

class ParentChildProgressPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const ParentChildProgressPage({super.key, this.forTeacher = false});

  final bool forTeacher;

  @override
  State<ParentChildProgressPage> createState() =>
      _ParentChildProgressPageState();
}

class _ParentChildProgressPageState extends State<ParentChildProgressPage> {
  int _selectedTab = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final controller = AudyScope.of(context);
      if (widget.forTeacher) {
        controller.loadTeacherStudents(force: true);
      } else {
        controller.loadParentChildren();
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = AudyScope.of(context);
    final profiles = widget.forTeacher
        ? controller.teacherStudents
        : controller.parentChildren;
    final selectedProfileId = widget.forTeacher
        ? controller.selectedTeacherStudentId
        : controller.selectedParentChildId;
    final child = widget.forTeacher
        ? controller.selectedTeacherStudent
        : controller.selectedParentChild;
    final isLoading = widget.forTeacher
        ? controller.isLoadingTeacherStudents
        : controller.isLoadingParentChildren;
    final errorMessage = widget.forTeacher
        ? controller.teacherStudentsError
        : controller.parentChildrenError;

    return AudyResponsivePage(
      builder: (context, adaptive) {
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            AudyBackButton(
              label: controller.tr('back_home'),
              onPressed: () {
                SoundService.instance.playTap();
                Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
              },
            ),
            SizedBox(height: adaptive.space(24)),
            Text(
              controller.tr('child_progress'),
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: adaptive.space(30),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                color: AudyColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: adaptive.space(8)),
            Text(
              controller.tr('child_progress_description'),
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: adaptive.space(16),
                color: AudyColors.textLight,
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: adaptive.space(24)),
            Wrap(
              spacing: adaptive.space(12),
              runSpacing: adaptive.space(12),
              children: [
                ProgressTabButton(
                  label: controller.tr('Progress'),
                  icon: Icons.query_stats_rounded,
                  selected: _selectedTab == 0,
                  color: const Color(0xFFBDD8F2),
                  onTap: () => _selectTab(0),
                ),
                ProgressTabButton(
                  label: controller.tr('add_rewards'),
                  icon: Icons.card_giftcard_outlined,
                  selected: _selectedTab == 1,
                  color: const Color(0xFFF8C7DF),
                  onTap: () => _selectTab(1),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            SizedBox(height: adaptive.space(20)),
            ChildProfileSelector(
              children: profiles,
              selectedChildId: selectedProfileId,
              isLoading: isLoading,
              errorMessage: errorMessage,
              label: widget.forTeacher
                  ? 'Selected student'
                  : controller.tr('selected_child'),
              emptyMessage: widget.forTeacher
                  ? 'No linked student accounts yet.'
                  : controller.tr('no_linked_children'),
              onRetry: () {
                if (widget.forTeacher) {
                  controller.loadTeacherStudents(force: true);
                } else {
                  controller.loadParentChildren(force: true);
                }
              },
              onSelected: widget.forTeacher
                  ? controller.selectTeacherStudent
                  : controller.selectParentChild,
            ),
            SizedBox(height: adaptive.space(22)),
            if (child != null && _selectedTab == 0)
              ChildLevelProgress(
                key: ValueKey('progress-${child.id}'),
                child: child,
                adaptive: adaptive,
              )
            else if (child != null && _selectedTab == 1)
              _ChildRewardsTab(
                key: ValueKey('rewards-${child.id}'),
                child: child,
                adaptive: adaptive,
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _selectTab(int tab) {
    SoundService.instance.playTap();
    setState(() => _selectedTab = tab);
  }
}

class ChildLevelProgress extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChildLevelProgress({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.adaptive,
    this.snapshot,
  });

  final ChildProgressSnapshot? snapshot;
  final UserProfile child;
  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;

  @override
  State<ChildLevelProgress> createState() => ChildLevelProgressState();
}

class ChildLevelProgressState extends State<ChildLevelProgress> {
  final _authService = AuthService();
  Map<String, dynamic>? _stats;
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final stats =
        widget.snapshot?.stats ??
        (widget.snapshot == null
            ? await _authService.fetchStudentStats(widget.child.id)
            : null);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _stats = stats;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) return const _LoadingPanel();

    final points = _stats?['learning_points'] as int? ?? 0;
    final gamesPlayed = _stats?['games_played'] as int? ?? 0;
    final streak = _stats?['day_streak'] as int? ?? 0;
    final level = _levelFor(points);
    final levelProgress =
        ((points - level.minimum) / (level.maximum - level.minimum)).clamp(
          0.0,
          1.0,
        );

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        AudyPanel(
          adaptive: widget.adaptive,
          child: Column(
            children: [
              Text(
                '${widget.child.name}\'s learning journey',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: widget.adaptive.space(22),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(20)),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 22,
                  vertical: 14,
                ),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: level.color,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  level.name,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    color: AudyColors.textPrimary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(20)),
              ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: levelProgress,
                  minHeight: 20,
                  backgroundColor: AudyColors.borderLight,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(level.color),
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(10)),
              Text(
                '$points / ${level.maximum} learning points',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                  color: AudyColors.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(18)),
        Flex(
          direction: widget.adaptive.isPhone ? Axis.vertical : Axis.horizontal,
          children: [
            _ProgressMetric(
              icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
              value: '$points',
              label: 'Points',
              color: const Color(0xFFFFF2A8),
              adaptive: widget.adaptive,
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: widget.adaptive.space(12),
              height: widget.adaptive.space(12),
            ),
            _ProgressMetric(
              icon: Icons.sports_esports_outlined,
              value: '$gamesPlayed',
              label: 'Games',
              color: const Color(0xFFBDD8F2),
              adaptive: widget.adaptive,
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: widget.adaptive.space(12),
              height: widget.adaptive.space(12),
            ),
            _ProgressMetric(
              icon: Icons.local_fire_department_outlined,
              value: '$streak',
              label: 'Day streak',
              color: const Color(0xFFF8C7DF),
              adaptive: widget.adaptive,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  _LevelInfo _levelFor(int points) {
    if (points >= 1000) {
      return const _LevelInfo('Master', 1000, 2000, Color(0xFFC9E8C1));
    }
    if (points >= 500) {
      return const _LevelInfo('Expert', 500, 1000, Color(0xFFFFF2A8));
    }
    if (points >= 250) {
      return const _LevelInfo('Explorer', 250, 500, Color(0xFFE7D8FA));
    }
    if (points >= 100) {
      return const _LevelInfo('Learner', 100, 250, Color(0xFFBDD8F2));
    }
    return const _LevelInfo('Beginner', 0, 100, Color(0xFFC9E8C1));
  }
}

class _ChildRewardsTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ChildRewardsTab({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.adaptive,
  });

  final UserProfile child;
  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;

  @override
  State<_ChildRewardsTab> createState() => _ChildRewardsTabState();
}

class _ChildRewardsTabState extends State<_ChildRewardsTab> {
  final _authService = AuthService();
  List<ChildRewardData> _rewards = const [];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isSaving = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final rewards = await _authService.fetchChildRewards(widget.child.id);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _rewards = rewards;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _addReward() async {
    final draft = await showDialog<RewardDraft>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AddRewardDialog(adaptive: widget.adaptive),
    );
    if (draft == null || !mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _isSaving = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final reward = await _authService.createChildReward(
        childId: widget.child.id,
        prize: draft.prize,
        conditionType: draft.condition.name,
        targetCount: draft.targetCount,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _rewards = [..._rewards, reward]);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', ''));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteReward(ChildRewardData reward) async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Remove reward?'),
          content: Text('Remove “${reward.prize}” from this child?'),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: const Text('Keep'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: AudyColors.error,
                foregroundColor: AudyColors.textOnColor,
              ),
              child: const Text('Remove'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      await _authService.deleteChildReward(reward.id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _rewards = _rewards.where((item) => item.id != reward.id).toList();
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', ''));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) return const _LoadingPanel();

    final currentUserId = AudyScope.of(context).currentUser?.id;
    final activeCount = _rewards.where((reward) => !reward.isCompleted).length;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Rewards for ${widget.child.name}',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: widget.adaptive.space(22),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: activeCount >= 3 || _isSaving ? null : _addReward,
              icon: _isSaving
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.add_rounded),
              label: const Text('Add Reward'),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8C7DF),
                foregroundColor: AudyColors.textPrimary,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (activeCount >= 3) ...[
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(8)),
          const Text(
            'Complete or remove an active reward before adding another.',
            style: TextStyle(color: AudyColors.textLight),
          ),
        ],
        if (_error != null) ...[
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(12)),
          _MessagePanel(message: _error!, isError: true),
        ],
        SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(18)),
        if (_rewards.isEmpty)
          AudyPanel(
            adaptive: widget.adaptive,
            child: const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 24),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.card_giftcard_outlined,
                    size: 52,
                    color: AudyColors.skyBlue,
                  ),
                  SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    'No rewards yet',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          )
        else
          ..._rewards.map(
            (reward) => Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: widget.adaptive.space(12)),
              child: _ChildRewardCard(
                reward: reward,
                adaptive: widget.adaptive,
                onDelete: reward.createdBy == currentUserId
                    ? () => _deleteReward(reward)
                    : null,
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _ChildRewardCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ChildRewardCard({
    required this.reward,
    required this.adaptive,
    this.onDelete,
  });
  final ChildRewardData reward;
  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;
  final VoidCallback? onDelete;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AudyPanel(
    adaptive: adaptive,
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.card_giftcard_outlined, color: AudyColors.skyBlue),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                reward.prize,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            if (onDelete != null)
              IconButton(
                onPressed: onDelete,
                tooltip: 'Remove reward',
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 48, minHeight: 48),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Text(
          '${reward.conditionType} · ${reward.currentProgress} / ${reward.targetCount}',
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        LinearProgressIndicator(value: reward.progressRatio, minHeight: 12),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          reward.isClaimed
              ? 'Claimed'
              : reward.isCompleted
              ? 'Completed'
              : 'In progress',
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class _ProgressMetric extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProgressMetric({
    required this.icon,
    required this.value,
    required this.label,
    required this.color,
    required this.adaptive,
  });

            textAlign: TextAlign.center,

          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return adaptive.isPhone
        ? SizedBox(width: double.infinity, child: panel)
        : Expanded(child: panel);
  }
}

class ProgressTabButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProgressTabButton({
```

## lib/src/features/parent/parent_child_analytics.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/audy_theme.dart';
import '../../data/models/child_progress_snapshot.dart';
import '../../core/audy_ui.dart';
import '../../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../dashboard_analytics.dart';

class ParentChildAnalytics extends StatefulWidget {
  const ParentChildAnalytics({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.adaptive,
    this.snapshot,
  });

  final ChildProgressSnapshot? snapshot;
  final UserProfile child;
  final AudyAdaptive adaptive;

  @override
  State<ParentChildAnalytics> createState() => _ParentChildAnalyticsState();
}

class _ParentChildAnalyticsState extends State<ParentChildAnalytics> {
  final _authService = AuthService();
  Map<String, dynamic>? _stats;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _sessions = const [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _assignments = const [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ParentChildAnalytics oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.child.id != widget.child.id ||
        oldWidget.snapshot != widget.snapshot) {
      _loadData();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    final snapshot = widget.snapshot;
    if (snapshot != null) {
      setState(() {
        _stats = snapshot.stats;
        _sessions = snapshot.sessions;
        _assignments = snapshot.assignments;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
      return;
    }
    final results = await Future.wait<dynamic>([
      _authService.fetchStudentStats(widget.child.id),
      _authService.fetchStudentSessions(widget.child.id),
      _authService.fetchAssignments(widget.child.id),
    ]);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _stats = results[0] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      _sessions = results[1] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      _assignments = results[2] as List<Map<String, dynamic>>;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
        child: Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AudyColors.skyBlue),
        ),
      );
    }

    final learningPoints = _stats?['learning_points'] as int? ?? 0;
    final gamesPlayed = _stats?['games_played'] as int? ?? 0;
    final dayStreak = _stats?['day_streak'] as int? ?? 0;
    final lastPlayed = _parseLastPlayed(_stats?['last_played_at']);

    return AudyPanel(
      adaptive: widget.adaptive,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              CircleAvatar(
                radius: 28,
                backgroundColor: AudyColors.blushPink.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.child_care_rounded,
                  color: AudyColors.blushPink,
                  size: 32,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 16),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      widget.child.name,
                      style: AudyTypography.headingSmall.copyWith(fontSize: 18),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'Age: ${widget.child.age}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        color: AudyColors.textLight,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(20)),
          const Divider(color: AudyColors.borderLight),
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(12)),
          Row(
            children: [
              _StatItem(
                label: 'Learning Points',
                value: '$learningPoints',
                icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                color: AudyColors.activityRewards,
              ),
              _StatItem(
                label: 'Games Played',
                value: '$gamesPlayed',
                icon: Icons.sports_esports_rounded,
                color: AudyColors.skyBlue,
              ),
              _StatItem(
                label: 'Day Streak',
                value: '$dayStreak days',
                icon: Icons.local_fire_department_rounded,
                color: Colors.orange,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(20)),
          const Divider(color: AudyColors.borderLight),
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(16)),
          StudentAnalyticsCharts(
            sessions: _sessions,
            assignments: _assignments,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: widget.adaptive.space(16)),
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(
                Icons.watch_later_outlined,
                size: 18,
                color: AudyColors.textLight,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                'Last active: $lastPlayed',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  color: AudyColors.textLight,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _parseLastPlayed(dynamic value) {
    if (value is! String) return 'Never';
    final parsed = DateTime.tryParse(value)?.toLocal();
    if (parsed == null) return 'Never';
    return '${parsed.day}/${parsed.month}/${parsed.year}';
  }
}

class _StatItem extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatItem({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
  });

  final String label;
  final String value;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color color;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Column(
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 20,
            backgroundColor: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 20),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            value,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              color: AudyColors.textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 2),
          Text(
            label,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: AudyColors.textLight,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/app_routes.dart';
```
